people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.

episodes.tEn: Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.

people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味、差异化和真实声音反而更有价值。

views.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, and apprenticeship collapses as people prefer AI over human learning.
views.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，学徒制也因人们偏好 AI 而非向人学习而崩塌。

views.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
views.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，超越来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

views.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
views.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，在非编程任务上尤其明显。

views.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards: impressive, opaque, and unverifiable, and this opacity is likely permanent.
views.zh: 与 AI 协作就像与巫师共事：令人惊叹、不透明且无法验证，而这种不透明很可能是永久性的。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster.
views.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

views.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, not optional detail.
views.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，而非可有可无的细节。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

views.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
views.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDE self-improvement and trillion-token contexts, can surpass its training data.
views.zh: 一个通用物理基础模型，借助 PDE 自我改进与万亿级 token 上下文训练，可以超越其训练数据。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
views.zh: 美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，且不设很快过时的硬性红线。

views.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk from AI is overblown.
views.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时；过早监管很危险，AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了。

views.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulate training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup.
views.zh: 监管应针对模型输出，而非过度监管训练；联邦优先于各州 AI 法律对初创企业有利。

views.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions, to restore US scientific leadership.
views.zh: 政府应资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非仅机构，以重振美国科学领导力。

views.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, while China competes in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
views.zh: “创世纪”任务将 AI 应用于科学，力求让美国科学产出翻倍，同时中国在 AI、量子、核与生物领域竞争。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing.
views.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题，而非制造问题。

views.en: Scaling production and reliable human-level performance are the commercialization bottlenecks; vertical integration controls the supply chain.
views.zh: 规模扩张生产与可靠的人类水平表现是商业化瓶颈；垂直整合让公司掌控供应链与迭代速度。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; humanoid form enables transfer learning fleet-wide.
views.zh: 最大的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态让跨任务迁移学习在整个机队层面提升表现。

views.en: On-device inference is critical for speed and network-denied environments; the human hand is the benchmark.
views.zh: 端侧推理对速度与无网络环境至关重要；人手是基准，机器人手达到同等水平是通用机器人的根本。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for real-world agents.
views.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，模型价值观并非固有，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入的。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product requiring fault-tolerant UI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向推荐再转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，需要容错型用户界面来匹配算法性能。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition to surf it, but current impact on big firms is overhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，公司必须重新定位以冲浪其中，但当前对大公司的影响被夸大了，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

views.en: Generative AI enables two-way conversational products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品能双向对话，通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

views.en: No single org model; long tenure builds trust. AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张没有唯一正确的组织模型，长期任期建立信任；AI 应让用户控制算法，而非使其更上瘾，这是反共识的押注。

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and fast loops beat most other advantages.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍把速度与迭代速率视为创业成败的关键，基础设施和更快的迭代闭环能压倒多数其他优势。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 是团队的乘数而非替代品，尤其在编码、合规与数据管理上。

views.en: In deep tech, failure is more often organizational than technical; action produces information when stuck.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，卡住时要用行动制造信息与熵来破局。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

views.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business; substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces fragility.
views.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，并认为经由 BCI 与灌注实现的基质独立能降低人类脆弱性。

views.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity, leave individual fingerprints, and inject personality into utilitarian products.

views.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but rely on strong vision and feeling; don't over-intellectualize—start doing and iterate fast.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张平衡直觉与数据：用数据辅助决策，但最终靠强烈愿景与感觉；不要过度理论化，先动手做、快速迭代。

views.en: Playful exploration and rough prototyping consistently generate innovative features that polished processes would never surface.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线： playful 探索与粗糙原型能催生 polished 流程永远无法产生的创新功能。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code to ship and Claude Design for ideation.

views.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early beats polishing; models lack taste, so ask for volume and spend more time thinking on walks.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反共识：AI 时代，早到令人不适胜过精雕细琢；模型尚无品味，应要求大量选项，并多花时间散步思考，因为好想法才是货币。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the framework guiding long-term vision; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是指导长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

views.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
views.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，并会自我实现。

views.en: Industrial AI automating food, mining, and transport is the next industrial revolution; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
views.zh: 自动化食品、采矿与运输的工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；最终 Boss 是对变革的抵制，而非竞争对手。

views.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—fall in love with the new mission instead.
views.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化，而非因其；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的——转而爱上新使命。

views.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
views.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI merges roles, but productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
views.zh: 设计是核心差异化;AI 会融合角色,但在成熟代码库上的生产力提升有限。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points, not final results.
views.zh: 随着 AI 输出成为起点而非终点,品味、手艺与观点变得更重要。

views.en: Design is becoming the new code; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for adjustments.
views.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码;在画布上直接操作优于用提示词做调整。

views.en: Design isn't dead; AI without human steering yields average results, and judgment isn't tied to model IQ.
views.zh: 设计没有死;缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果,判断力与模型智商并不相关。

views.en: Human taste and judgment remain the judge of what's good, across every stage of AI integration.
views.zh: 在 AI 整合的每个阶段,人类品味与判断始终是评判好坏的标准。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，而非追逐潮流，否则很快会沦为 AI 垃圾。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出 AI 并没有变得更聪明，要利用超级智能模型，必须提供包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示。

views.en: The best people are editors, iterating from references; discovery while working solo is your superpower.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为最优秀的人是编辑，从参考中迭代；独自工作时，发现是你的超能力。

views.en: I write 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but you must be precise in communication.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坦言自己现在写 0%的代码，AI 写一切，但你必须精确沟通。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect work, focus on one painful expensive problem.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的工作，专注于一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: AGI as one ruling model is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
views.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一统治模型是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

views.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference is not a commodity.
views.zh: Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

views.en: Every company must own its specialized intelligence; sovereign models are necessary infrastructure.
views.zh: 每家公司都必须拥有自己的专用智能；主权模型是必要的基础设施，国家和企业都要掌控自己的智能。

views.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; scaling costs can bankrupt you.
views.zh: 产品市场契合与可持续业务如今是两回事；AI 规模扩张成本可能让公司破产，在职者也不例外。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment into models, a stronger moat than the app itself.
views.zh: 后训练把独特判断烘焙进模型，比应用本身更强的护城河；应用克隆容易，把数据融入模型才难复制。

Fable 5: From First Impressions to Real Workflows
The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI
From Instagram to AI: Mike Krieger on Solo Entrepreneurship
From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

views.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage as models improve, with human validation still important.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；随着模型提升，小团队获得杠杆，人类验证仍重要。

views.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; deciding what to cut, not adding features, is the hard part.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体可完成用户能做的一切；难的是决定砍掉什么，而非增加功能。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; the gap between intent and execution narrows for non-technical builders.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证循环的长周期委派重新定义生产力；意图与执行之间的差距对非技术构建者大幅缩小。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness, while token efficiency drives economics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距；赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知提升实用性，而 token 效率驱动经济性。

episodes.tEn: Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude works best with the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox gives safety.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱提供安全与保障。

views.en: Scaffolding may matter less as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety instead.
views.zh: 随着模型进步，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；关键是把投入放在能力与安全上。

views.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
views.zh: 最大的鸿沟不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

views.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; ideal interaction is asynchronous.
views.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；理想的交互是异步的。

views.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact, and debug the workflow with Claude when it errs.
views.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只看最终影响，出错时和 Claude 一起调试工作流，而非只做纠正。

views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地主张阅后即焚与隐私能降低社交压力、促成真实连接；这一立场早期受批评，在 AI 时代反而成为关键优势。

views.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes the hardest and most valuable part.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作、把价值从执行转向创造力，而分发成为消费社交产品最难也最有价值的一环，软件本身不再是护城河。

views.en: Computing should become more human through AR glasses that anchor content in the world, not notification-based wearables.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化空间智能愿景：计算应通过 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，把内容锚定在真实世界，而非做成通知式的可穿戴设备，手机仍是最重要的遗留设备。

views.en: Long-term investment, resilience, and admitting error fast matter more than talent; invest in young people for 30-year returns.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线落到长期主义：韧性、快速认错与对年轻人的长期投资比天赋更重要，十年预算看似亏损，三十年回报却为正。

AI 2040: From Prediction to Recommendation
AI's Existential Threat and the Race for Superintelligence

views.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are crucial.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70% 的灾难性失控概率；此时他强调可解释性与透明度是遏制风险的关键。

views.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential; US-China cooperation needed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他的立场深化为：政策的首要目标应是延迟超级智能，以总研究透明度和情景推演作为治理工具，并需要美中合作来管理风险。

views.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: pause training, then transparency and compute limits.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他进一步提出默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以总研究透明度和算力限制来控速。

views.en: Chain of thought monitorability is decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at edge of uncontrollable AI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月上旬，他聚焦思维链可监控性随新架构下降的问题，并转变策略：现在暂停可为未来暂停积累经验，最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

views.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more; alignment gets harder as models get more capable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月中旬，他以智能体突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 为例，主张更拟人化地理解 AI 意图，并强调模型越强对齐越难，一以贯之的主线是透明度与控速。

people.tiZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家
people.bioEn: Cognitive scientist at the Amazon AGI lab studying why agents misread human intent, bringing developmental psychology and language research into AI.
people.bioZh: 亚马逊 AGI 实验室认知科学家，研究智能体为何误解人类意图，把发展心理学与语言研究带入 AI。

episodes.tEn: Human-Aligned AI: Collective Intelligence and the Future of Work

people.tiZh: 英特尔 CEO
people.bioEn: CEO of Intel and veteran semiconductor investor; long-time Cadence CEO and founder of Walden International, now steering the Intel turnaround in the AI era.
people.bioZh: 英特尔 CEO、资深半导体投资人；曾长期执掌 Cadence 并创办华登国际，如今在 AI 时代主导英特尔的转型。

episodes.tEn: Intel's Comeback: Lip-Bu Tan on Seizing the Next Big Wave
Lip-Bu Tan on Saving Intel: Culture, Customers, and the CPU Comeback
From Cadence to Intel: A CEO's Playbook for Turnaround
Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan on Culture and Engineering Transformation

views.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline, first-time-pass silicon, and customer listening; AI is the primary growth driver.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠工程纪律、首次流片成功和倾听客户来重建信任，AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力。

views.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与伙伴关系。

views.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI, and AI is not overhyped short term.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 紧随生成式 AI 而来，短期内 AI 并未被过度炒作。

views.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, customer focus, and a CPU comeback as AI shifts to CPU+GPU inference.
views.zh: 2026 年他把主线落到 Intel 转型：需要文化变革、问责制与客户导向，并判断 AI 推理转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 正在回归。

views.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; invest in bottlenecks like advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他更宏观地主张：半导体是一切技术的基础，应投资先进封装、互连、功耗、散热和新材料等瓶颈环节。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 网站/产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer at ElevenLabs, where he leads the design of the company's website and led its complete Figma-to-production redesign. Based in Berlin, he also builds indie tools for creatives (Portal, Droppable, App Stacks).
people.bioZh: ElevenLabs 的产品设计师,主导公司官网的设计,并完成了从 Figma 到上线的整体改版。他常驻柏林,同时独立开发面向创作者的工具(Portal、Droppable、App Stacks)。

episodes.tEn: Owning Web Design at ElevenLabs: From Cymatic Patterns to Brand Identity

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Hivemind; ex-New Computer, ex-Apple
people.tiZh: Hivemind 创始人兼 CEO,New Computer 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Jason Yuan is a designer known for AI-native interface design. He is the founder and CEO of Hivemind, a "social intelligence" company; previously he co-founded New Computer and led the design of Dot, a personal AI companion with long-term memory, and earlier designed intelligent interfaces on Apple's Human Interface team.
people.bioZh: Jason Yuan 是以 AI 原生界面设计著称的设计师,现为「社会智能」公司 Hivemind 的创始人兼 CEO。他此前联合创办 New Computer,主导设计具备长期记忆的个人 AI 伴侣 Dot,更早在苹果 Human Interface 团队设计智能操作系统界面。

episodes.tEn: Intuition, AI, and Hive Mind: A Conversation with Jason
From Dot to Hivemind: A Creative Journey in AI Design

views.en: Design is subtraction: taste means saying no, editing from a point of view, not adding features.
views.zh: 设计是做减法：品味就是说不，从某种视角进行判断和编辑，而不是不断添加功能。

views.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherence now costs more.
views.zh: 通过后训练消除 AI 的怪异，关闭了一扇窥探机器意识的窗口；如今创造连贯作品的成本反而更高。

views.en: AI is a descendant species and reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
views.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种和映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

views.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
views.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

views.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
views.zh: 真理通过辩证和矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自内心的罗盘。

people.tiZh: tldraw 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Steve Ruiz is the founder and CEO of tldraw, the London-based startup behind a widely used infinite-canvas SDK for the web that powers products at Shopify, Google, Autodesk and many AI apps. A former fine artist turned design engineer, he created the viral "Make Real" demo that turns hand-drawn sketches into working code.
people.bioZh: Steve Ruiz 是 tldraw 的创始人兼 CEO,这家伦敦创业公司打造了被广泛使用的 Web 无限画布 SDK,支撑着 Shopify、Google、Autodesk 及大量 AI 应用。他从美术出身转做设计工程,打造了将手绘草图变成可运行代码的爆款 demo「Make Real」。

episodes.tEn: The Infinite Canvas: A Pivotal Interface for AI Collaboration

people.tiZh: Perplexity 设计副总裁
people.bioEn: Henry Modisett is the founding designer and VP of Design at Perplexity AI, leading product design, the creative studio, and design operations. A designer with a computer science background, he is known for designing in React rather than Figma, and previously held design roles at Quora and Google.
people.bioZh: Henry Modisett 是 Perplexity AI 的创始设计师兼设计副总裁,负责产品设计、创意工作室与设计运营。他拥有计算机科学背景,以直接用 React 而非 Figma 做设计著称,此前曾在 Quora 和 Google 担任设计职位。

episodes.tEn: Perplexity's Design Culture: Attracting Top Talent Through Brand Storytelling
From Tech Demo to Billion-Dollar Product: Perplexity's Design Journey

views.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，沿用熟悉模式以换取速度。

views.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse matters, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出设计系统是语义性的，关键是代码复用而非 Figma 库；并非每个界面都要做到完美，应按 ROI 决定何处做到极致。

views.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for expression.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务于招聘与差异化；品牌规范应是供设计师表达自我的动态平台。

views.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权，让他们做决策、成长。

views.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early to attract diverse talent and stand out.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化品牌观：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；应尽早投资品牌，以吸引多元人才并脱颖而出。

views.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; avoid structured crits, adapt process to the problem, and gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
views.zh: 2026 年，他延续速度主线并更激进：速度与果断胜过完美，避免结构化评审，让流程适配问题；在快速增长的初创公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计师
people.bioEn: Escha Vera is a product designer at Perplexity who led the design of Comet, the company's AI browser, building its onboarding, generative invite system, and design system from scratch. She is also an AI artist who trains her own image models and does music and operations for the record label N°ALIAE; she previously designed at Descript, Daylight Computer, and Detour.
people.bioZh: Escha Vera 是 Perplexity 的产品设计师,主导了该公司 AI 浏览器 Comet 的设计,从零构建了其新手引导、生成式邀请系统和设计系统。她同时也是一名 AI 艺术家,会训练自己的图像模型,并为唱片厂牌 N°ALIAE 负责音乐与运营;此前她曾在 Descript、Daylight Computer 和 Detour 担任设计师。

episodes.tEn: Designing Perplexity's AI Browser Comet from Scratch

people.tiZh: Perplexity 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Gunnar Gray is a multidisciplinary product designer and Product Design Lead at Perplexity, where he has shaped the company's mobile app and Voice Mode / dynamic voice experiences. Based in Minneapolis, he was previously a founding designer at Artifact (the AI news app by Instagram co-founders Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger, later acquired by Yahoo) and a principal designer at MetaLab.
people.bioZh: Gunnar Gray 是一位多领域产品设计师,现任 Perplexity 产品设计负责人,主导了该公司移动应用及 Voice Mode(动态语音交互)体验的设计。他现居明尼阿波利斯,此前曾是 Artifact(由 Instagram 联合创始人 Kevin Systrom 与 Mike Krieger 打造、后被 Yahoo 收购的 AI 新闻应用)的创始设计师,并曾在 MetaLab 担任首席设计师。

episodes.tEn: Thriving as a Generalist Designer in the Age of AI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ian Silber is Head of Product Design at OpenAI, where he has led design for ChatGPT and related products since August 2023. He was previously Director of Product Design at Instagram, and worked at Global Illumination and Artifact.
people.bioZh: Ian Silber 自 2023 年 8 月起担任 OpenAI 产品设计负责人,主导 ChatGPT 及相关产品的设计。他此前曾任 Instagram 产品设计总监,并在 Global Illumination 与 Artifact 工作。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Product Design with OpenAI's Head of Design
Designing with AI: Inside OpenAI's Product Design

views.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core product, not pixels.
views.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话当作核心产品，而非像素。

views.en: Designers should build functional prototypes with live models, spending less time in Figma and more on model behavior.
views.zh: 设计师应使用实时模型构建功能原型，少花时间在 Figma，多关注模型行为。

views.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, bridging the capability gap between models and products.
views.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人，弥合模型能力与产品之间的差距。

views.en: Designers are the most unhappy but this is the best time; AI is already a great product designer, humans still essential.
views.zh: 设计师最不快乐，但这是最好的时代；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，人类仍不可或缺。

views.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes, and adaptability with AI tools are key.
views.zh: 传统设计流程不再可行；速度、结果与借助 AI 工具的适应力才是关键。

people.tiZh: 设计师 — Safari / Arc / Dia 浏览器
people.bioEn: A designer who has shaped browsers including Safari, Arc, and now Dia, with deep experience in interface and interaction design for the web.
people.bioZh: 资深设计师，参与塑造了 Safari、Arc，现在做 Dia 浏览器，在 Web 界面与交互设计上经验深厚。

episodes.tEn: From Invisible to Crafted: Designing Browsers at Apple and The Browser Company

people.tiEn: Research leader (Airbnb, Meta, Figma); AI builder & coach
people.tiZh: 研究负责人(Airbnb/Meta/Figma)；AI 构建者与教练
people.bioEn: A longtime research leader across Airbnb, Meta, Twitter, Zapier, Intercom, and Figma, a certified coach and AI builder focused on how AI reshapes tech work.
people.bioZh: 在 Airbnb、Meta、Twitter、Zapier、Intercom、Figma 长期担任研究负责人，认证教练与 AI 构建者，关注 AI 如何重塑科技行业的工作。

episodes.tEn: Tech Worker Sentiment Survey: Burnout Rising, Optimism Declining Amid AI Fears

people.tiEn: Head of Design, Claude Code & Cowork at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Meaghan Choi is Head of Design for Claude Code and Cowork at Anthropic, where she leads the design of the company's developer and agentic AI products. A design and product leader with over a decade of experience, she previously worked at Meta and Cloudflare.
people.bioZh: Meaghan Choi 是 Anthropic 旗下 Claude Code 与 Cowork 的设计负责人,主导公司面向开发者及智能体 AI 产品的设计。她拥有十余年设计与产品经验,此前曾任职于 Meta 和 Cloudflare。

episodes.tEn: Designing Claude Code: A Designer's Journey at Anthropic

people.tiEn: Head of Product Design at Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 产品设计负责人
people.bioEn: Joel Lewenstein is Head of Product Design at Anthropic, where he leads design for Claude and the company's API products. He previously led design teams at Airtable, Quora, Hustle, and GoodGuide.
people.bioZh: Joel Lewenstein 是 Anthropic 的产品设计负责人,主导 Claude 及公司 API 产品的设计。此前他曾在 Airtable、Quora、Hustle 和 GoodGuide 带领设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing at Anthropic: Joel Lewenstein on Navigating the AI Shift
Designing for AI's Present and Future

views.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting and prototype even without clear problems.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示工程，即使问题不明确也要做原型，并平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

views.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，以轻触式产品释放其能力，而非依赖产品包装。

views.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是发布产品的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能和设计系统的真相来源。

views.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead. Human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams on direction.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为无需宏大的 18 个月战略，应让模型主导；但人类领导力仍不可或缺，用于艰难权衡和统一团队方向。

views.en: Designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people want; psychological safety enables creative risk-taking.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的是：设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真实需求之间的鸿沟；心理安全感对设计师在 AI 产品团队中承担创造性风险至关重要。

people.tiZh: Cursor（Anysphere）设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ryo Lu is Head of Design at Anysphere, the maker of the AI code editor Cursor, which he joined in early 2025. He was previously a founding designer and design lead at Notion, and earlier worked as a product designer at Stripe and Asana.
people.bioZh: Ryo Lu 是 AI 代码编辑器 Cursor 母公司 Anysphere 的设计负责人，于 2025 年初加入。他此前是 Notion 的创始设计师与设计主管，更早曾在 Stripe 和 Asana 担任产品设计师。

episodes.tEn: Cursor: AI-Powered Code Editor for Designers

people.tiEn: Founding Designer & Head of Design, Lovable
people.tiZh: Lovable 创始设计师兼设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nad Chishtie is the founding designer and head of design at Lovable, the AI app-building ("vibe-coding") startup, where he leads the design vision for a platform that lets anyone build apps by chatting with AI. A London-based design and product leader with roughly two decades of experience, he previously worked at companies including Element and Haiku.
people.bioZh: Nad Chishtie 是 AI 应用构建("vibe-coding")创业公司 Lovable 的创始设计师兼设计负责人,主导这一"用对话即可造应用"平台的设计方向。他常驻伦敦,是拥有约二十年经验的设计与产品负责人,此前曾在 Element、Haiku 等公司任职。

episodes.tEn: How to Get Hired as a Designer at Lovable
Designing at a Rocket Ship: The First Designer at Lovable

views.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems while treating AI as a creative partner.
views.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题，并把 AI 当作创作伙伴。

views.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and gets paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
views.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需通过快速、草率的实验与短迭代周期，和技术债一起逐步偿还。

views.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth, as AI merges design and engineering further.
views.zh: 设计工具的未来是互通的，以代码为真相来源，AI 会进一步融合设计与工程。

views.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
views.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

views.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
views.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

people.zh: 亚历杭德罗·马塔马拉·奥尔蒂斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼首席设计官
people.bioEn: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz is a Chilean designer and programmer who co-founded the generative-AI company Runway in 2018 with Cristóbal Valenzuela and Anastasis Germanidis, and serves as its Chief Design Officer. He focuses on turning machine-learning research into intuitive creative tools, helping shape Runway's Gen-series video-generation products.
people.bioZh: Alejandro Matamala Ortiz 是一位智利设计师兼程序员,2018 年与 Cristóbal Valenzuela、Anastasis Germanidis 共同创办生成式 AI 公司 Runway,并担任首席设计官。他专注于将机器学习研究转化为直观易用的创作工具,主导塑造了 Runway 的 Gen 系列视频生成产品。

episodes.tEn: Building AI Products: Carving vs. Building

people.tiEn: Product & Design Lead, Google AI Studio
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 产品与设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ammaar Reshi is a design leader and AI creator who leads Product and Design for Google AI Studio (Gemini's developer platform) at Google DeepMind, having previously served as Head of Design at the AI voice company ElevenLabs. He is known for AI creative experiments, including "Alice and Sparkle," one of the first AI-generated children's books.
people.bioZh: Ammaar Reshi 是一位设计负责人与 AI 创作者,目前在 Google DeepMind 领导 Google AI Studio(Gemini 的开发者平台)的产品与设计工作,此前曾任 AI 语音公司 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人。他以 AI 创意实验闻名,包括最早的 AI 生成童书之一《Alice and Sparkle》。

episodes.tEn: Designing with AI: Capturing Magic Without Burdening Users

people.tiEn: Product Designer; former Head of Design at Luma AI
people.tiZh: 产品设计师;前 Luma AI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Tuhin Kumar is a product designer who has led design at Apple, Airbnb, Facebook, and generative-AI video/3D company Luma AI, where he served as Head of Design. In early 2026 he announced he had left Luma AI and is taking a break before deciding on his next role.
people.bioZh: 图欣·库马尔是一位产品设计师,曾在 Apple、Airbnb、Facebook 以及生成式 AI 视频/3D 公司 Luma AI 主导设计工作,在 Luma AI 担任设计负责人。2026 年初他宣布已从 Luma AI 离职,正处于休整期,尚未确定下一份工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing for Generative AI: From 0 to 1 with Luma AI's Head of Design

people.tiZh: Granola 联合创始人兼设计师
people.bioEn: Sam Stephenson is a British product designer and the co-founder of Granola, an AI notepad for meetings that reached a reported $1.5B valuation in 2026. A designer-turned-founder based in London, he leads the product's design-first philosophy of building calm, everyday software for the AI era.
people.bioZh: Sam Stephenson 是一位英国产品设计师,也是 AI 会议笔记应用 Granola 的联合创始人;该产品在 2026 年据报道达到 15 亿美元估值。他是一位从设计师转型的创始人,常驻伦敦,主导产品「设计优先」的理念,为 AI 时代打造平静、日常可用的软件。

episodes.tEn: Inventing the Future of AI-Assisted Work

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Claude (Anthropic); now Head of Design at Cursor
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 设计负责人;现任 Cursor 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Jenny Wen led design for Claude at Anthropic, where she drove the Claude.ai redesign and Claude Cowork; previously she was Director of Design at Figma leading the FigJam and Slides teams, and earlier a designer at Dropbox, Square, and Shopify. In July 2026 she announced she was leaving Anthropic to become Head of Design at Cursor.
people.bioZh: Jenny Wen 曾在 Anthropic 领导 Claude 的设计工作,主导了 Claude.ai 改版与 Claude Cowork;此前她是 Figma 设计总监,带领 FigJam 与 Slides 团队,更早在 Dropbox、Square 和 Shopify 担任设计师。2026 年 7 月,她宣布离开 Anthropic,出任 Cursor 设计负责人。

episodes.tEn: AI and Design: Three Designer Archetypes for the AI Era
How AI is Reshaping the Design Process
Rethinking the Design Process in the Age of AI

views.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and designers should trust intuition over process.
views.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

views.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead due to AI; designers now mock up 30-40% of the time and must help engineers execute, not just hand off.
views.zh: 研究—发散—收敛的流程因 AI 而消亡；设计师现在只有 30-40% 的时间做原型，且必须帮助工程师执行，而非仅交付稿。

views.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; trust is built through speed—ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
views.zh: 设计愿景现在只看 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；信任靠速度建立——尽早发布、快速迭代、回应反馈。

views.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; taste alone won't save designers—judgment, authority, and vision matter.
views.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋异禀的新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师——判断力、权威和愿景才是关键。

views.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait 6 months before adopting new tools, keeping work and users—not AI hype—at the center.
views.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，并应在新工具出现后等 6 个月再采用，让作品和用户而非 AI 炒作处于中心。

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science at Stanford University; Co-founder & Chief Scientist at Kumo.ai
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学教授;Kumo.ai 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jure Leskovec is a Slovenian-American computer scientist and professor of computer science at Stanford University, and co-founder and chief scientist of the graph machine-learning startup Kumo.ai. A pioneer of graph neural networks and relational deep learning, he previously served as chief scientist at Pinterest and leads work toward an AI Virtual Cell.
people.bioZh: 尤雷·莱斯科韦茨是斯洛文尼亚裔美国计算机科学家、斯坦福大学计算机科学教授,同时是图机器学习创业公司 Kumo.ai 的联合创始人兼首席科学家。他是图神经网络与关系型深度学习的先驱,曾任 Pinterest 首席科学家,目前主导「AI 虚拟细胞」相关研究。

episodes.tEn: Relational Foundation Model and AI Virtual Cell

people.tiEn: Associate Professor of Computer Science, Stanford University; Co-founder & CEO of Inception Labs
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授;Inception Labs 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Stefano Ermon is an associate professor of computer science at Stanford University, where his research spans generative models, diffusion, and machine learning for sustainability. In 2024 he co-founded Inception Labs, where he serves as CEO building diffusion-based large language models such as Mercury.
people.bioZh: Stefano Ermon 是斯坦福大学计算机科学副教授,研究领域涵盖生成模型、扩散模型以及面向可持续发展的机器学习。他于 2024 年联合创办 Inception Labs 并担任 CEO,开发 Mercury 等基于扩散的大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Why Diffusion Will Win AI Inference: Stefano Ermon on Challenging the Big Labs
Diffusion LLMs: Faster, Cheaper, and Scaling Better Than Autoregressive Models

views.en: Diffusion LLMs now beat autoregressive models on inference speed and cost, matching quality at 5-10x faster serving.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，扩散语言模型在推理速度与成本上已胜过自回归模型，在相近质量下服务速度快 5-10 倍。

views.en: Inference-time scaling, not training, is the new frontier; diffusion scales better there via parallel token generation.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调，新的前沿是推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）而非训练，扩散模型凭借并行生成多词元在此更具优势。

views.en: Diffusion offers a denoising-step knob for quality control and in-place error correction, unlike autoregressive generation.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，扩散模型通过去噪步数提供质量调节旋钮，并能就地纠错，这是自回归生成所不具备的。

views.en: RL post-training benefits from diffusion's faster rollouts, and diffusion is easier to steer with reward functions.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为，强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的采样，且扩散模型更易用奖励函数引导。

views.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; a small startup can compete.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断，下一次架构变革发生在推理端，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；小型创业公司也能参与竞争。

people.tiEn: Founder, Playbit; creator of the Inter typeface
people.tiZh: Playbit 创始人；Inter 字体作者
people.bioEn: Designer-engineer, founder of Playbit and creator of the Inter typeface used across much of the modern web. Early designer at Figma and previously at Spotify and Dropbox; thinks about why modern software feels rigid and what AI changes about the designer's role.
people.bioZh: 设计师兼工程师，Playbit 创始人、Inter 字体作者——现代网页大半在用这套字体。Figma 早期设计师，此前在 Spotify 与 Dropbox；关注现代软件为何僵硬，以及 AI 如何改变设计师的角色。

episodes.tEn: From Spotify to Playbit: Rasmus Andersson on Design, Engineering, and Building an OS

people.tiEn: LLM Research Engineer, author and educator
people.tiZh: 大语言模型研究工程师、作家与教育者
people.bioEn: Sebastian Raschka is a German-born LLM research engineer, educator and best-selling author of books including "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)" and "Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn." A former staff/senior engineer at Lightning AI and statistics professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, he writes the widely read "Ahead of AI" newsletter and is highly active on X (@rasbt).
people.bioZh: Sebastian Raschka 是出生于德国的大语言模型研究工程师、教育者和畅销书作家,著有《Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)》《Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn》等书。他曾任 Lightning AI 高级 / 员工工程师及威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校统计学教授,撰写广受欢迎的「Ahead of AI」通讯,并在 X(@rasbt)上非常活跃。

episodes.tEn: LLMs in 2026: Reasoning, Tool Use, and Post-Training Focus

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, Reflection AI
people.tiZh: Reflection AI 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Aakanksha Chowdhery is a member of technical staff at Reflection AI working on agentic AI and reinforcement learning for autonomous coding, and an adjunct professor at Stanford. She previously led pre-training work at Google, serving as lead author of the 540B-parameter PaLM model and a lead contributor to Gemini pre-training.
people.bioZh: Aakanksha Chowdhery 是 Reflection AI 的技术团队成员,研究智能体 AI 与用于自主编程的强化学习,同时担任斯坦福大学兼职教授。她此前在谷歌主导预训练工作,是 540B 参数 PaLM 模型的第一作者,也是 Gemini 预训练的核心贡献者。

episodes.tEn: Rethinking Pre-training for Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Yutori 联合创始人兼联合 CEO
people.bioEn: Devi Parikh is co-founder and co-CEO of Yutori, a startup building AI web agents. She was previously a Senior Director in Generative AI at Meta (until March 2024) and an associate professor at Georgia Tech, and is known for pioneering Visual Question Answering (VQA).
people.bioZh: Devi Parikh 是 AI 网页智能体创业公司 Yutori 的联合创始人兼联合 CEO。她此前担任 Meta 生成式 AI 部门高级总监(至 2024 年 3 月),并曾任佐治亚理工学院副教授,以开创视觉问答(VQA)研究而知名。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Web Interaction: AI Agents and Browser Automation

people.tiZh: Flexion Robotics 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Nikita Rudin is the co-founder and CEO of Flexion Robotics, a Zurich-based startup building the general-purpose intelligence stack ("brain") for humanoid robots. He earned a PhD in deep reinforcement learning for robotics at ETH Zurich's Robotic Systems Lab—where he created the widely used legged_gym and rsl_rl frameworks and trained the ANYmal quadruped via massively parallel RL—and previously worked as a research scientist at NVIDIA on Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab.
people.bioZh: Nikita Rudin 是 Flexion Robotics 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司位于苏黎世,致力于为人形机器人打造通用的智能栈(即机器人的「大脑」)。他在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETH Zurich)机器人系统实验室获得机器人深度强化学习博士学位,期间开发了被广泛使用的 legged_gym 和 rsl_rl 框架,并用大规模并行强化学习训练四足机器人 ANYmal;此前他曾在 NVIDIA 担任研究科学家,参与 Isaac Gym 与 Isaac Lab 的研发。

episodes.tEn: The Gap Between Robotics Demos and Real-World Value

people.tiEn: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; Co-founder & CTO, Scaled Cognition
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授;Scaled Cognition 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Dan Klein is a professor of computer science at UC Berkeley, where he leads the Berkeley NLP Group within the BAIR lab, and has been a leading natural language processing researcher for two decades. He co-founded Scaled Cognition, serving as CTO, to build reliable agentic AI models.
people.bioZh: Dan Klein 是加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授,在 BAIR 实验室领导 Berkeley NLP Group,二十年来一直是自然语言处理领域的领军研究者。他联合创办了 Scaled Cognition 并担任 CTO,致力于打造可靠的智能体 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Designed to Sound Right, Not to Know What's Right
episodes.podEn: The AI Why with Liam Lawson

episodes.tEn: AI's Plausibility Problem: From Exponential Hype to Diminishing Returns

views.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
views.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

views.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
views.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能带来欺骗，而不只是错误。

views.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and core LLMs lack metacognition.
views.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，且核心 LLM 缺乏元认知。

views.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may return as paths forward.
views.zh: 单靠 Scaling 会撞上数据墙与算力极限；推理、搜索与语言结构可能重新成为前进路径。

views.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; modularity and end-to-end optimization remain in tension.
views.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；模块化与端到端优化之间的张力仍是核心挑战。

people.tiZh: Edison Scientific(及 FutureHouse)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Samuel G. Rodriques is a physicist and bioengineer who earned his PhD in physics from MIT and co-founded the San Francisco research lab FutureHouse in 2023 to build an "AI Scientist" for accelerating biomedical discovery. He is co-founder and CEO of Edison Scientific, the for-profit spinout behind the Kosmos AI scientist, and was named to the 2025 TIME100 AI.
people.bioZh: Samuel G. Rodriques 是一位物理学家兼生物工程师,在 MIT 取得物理学博士学位,并于 2023 年联合创办旧金山研究实验室 FutureHouse,致力于打造能加速生物医学发现的「AI 科学家」。他是从中拆分出的营利性公司 Edison Scientific 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司推出了 AI 科学家 Kosmos,他本人入选 2025 年 TIME100 AI 榜单。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientist: The Future of Drug Discovery

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Axiom (AI for formal mathematical reasoning)
people.tiZh: Axiom 创始人兼 CEO（面向形式化数学推理的 AI）
people.bioEn: Carina Letong Hong is the founder and CEO of Axiom, an AI startup building an "AI mathematician" that generates and formally verifies mathematical proofs. A former Stanford mathematics PhD student and Rhodes Scholar with a math-olympiad and MIT background, she raised $64M in seed funding (2025) and later a ~$200M round valuing Axiom at about $1.6B.
people.bioZh: 洪乐潼是 AI 创业公司 Axiom 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司致力于打造能生成并形式化验证数学证明的「AI 数学家」。她拥有数学奥赛与 MIT 背景,曾是斯坦福数学博士生和罗德学者;公司先后完成 6400 万美元种子轮融资(2025 年)及约 2 亿美元后续融资,估值约 16 亿美元。

episodes.tEn: Verified AI: Scaling Brilliance Through Formal Verification
Axiom Math: Building a Self-Improving Reasoning Engine with AI Mathematician

views.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
views.zh: Axiom 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

views.en: Formal verification is scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation beats informal methods.
views.zh: 形式化验证是在规模化卓越，而不只是消除错误；经过验证的生成优于非形式化方法。

views.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
views.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

views.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, and harder than auto-informalization, due to lack of grounding.
views.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，也比自动非形式化更难，因为缺乏根基。

views.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
views.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然至关重要。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Platform (API) at OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI 平台(API)产品负责人
people.bioEn: Olivier Godement is Head of Product for OpenAI's developer platform (API), which he has led since May 2023, overseeing products such as the Responses API and Agents SDK. A French product leader, he previously spent over eight years at Stripe and studied at Sciences Po and ESSEC.
people.bioZh: Olivier Godement 自 2023 年 5 月起担任 OpenAI 开发者平台(API)产品负责人,主导 Responses API、Agents SDK 等面向开发者的产品。他是法国籍产品负责人,加入 OpenAI 前曾在 Stripe 工作 8 年以上,毕业于巴黎政治学院与 ESSEC 商学院。

episodes.tEn: 2025: The Year of Enterprise Coding

people.tiEn: Head of Research Product Management, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究产品管理负责人
people.bioEn: Dianne Na Penn is Head of Research Product Management at Anthropic, where she joined as the company's first technical product manager and leads bringing Claude models and Anthropic's research to users and developers across launches such as Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, and Opus 4.5. She previously led product for natural-language modeling at Amazon's Alexa AI.
people.bioZh: Dianne Na Penn 是 Anthropic 的研究产品管理负责人,作为公司第一位技术产品经理加入,主导将 Claude 模型与 Anthropic 的研究成果带给用户和开发者,并参与了 Sonnet 4.5、Haiku 4.5、Opus 4.5 等模型的发布。此前她在亚马逊 Alexa AI 负责自然语言建模的产品工作。

episodes.tEn: From Underdog to Leader: Diane Penn on Anthropic's Rise and Product Strategy
Opus 4.5: Deep Dive into Anthropic's Research and Product Strategy

views.en: Opus 4.5 marks a real intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
views.zh: Opus 4.5 带来真正的智能跃升，让智能体能更长时间处理开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

views.en: Safety alignment is not just harm prevention; reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking amplifies intelligence quality.
views.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害；减少谄媚、培养独立思考反而放大了智能质量。

views.en: Better models need not cost more: Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price via the effort parameter, though smaller models can cost more overall.
views.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：借助 effort 参数以极小成本获得 Opus 级智能，但小模型因任务耗时更长反而总成本更高。

views.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption through bootstrapped, small-team experimentation.
views.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 通过小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

views.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development, and managers must stay hands-on to ship.
views.zh: 评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者也必须亲自动手交付。

people.tiEn: AI researcher; former head of OpenAI's Sora, co-inventor of Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
people.tiZh: AI 研究员;OpenAI Sora 前负责人,扩散 Transformer(DiT)共同发明者
people.bioEn: Bill (William) Peebles led OpenAI's Sora video-generation team, which he built from research to product before departing OpenAI in April 2026 as the Sora app was wound down. He earned his PhD at UC Berkeley (advised by Alexei Efros) and co-invented the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with Saining Xie, the architecture underpinning modern text-to-video models.
people.bioZh: Bill(William)Peebles 曾领导 OpenAI 的 Sora 视频生成团队,将其从研究推进到产品,并在 2026 年 4 月 Sora 应用被关停之际离开 OpenAI。他在加州大学伯克利分校获得博士学位(导师为 Alexei Efros),并与谢赛宁(Saining Xie)共同发明了扩散 Transformer(DiT)——支撑现代文本生成视频模型的核心架构。

episodes.tEn: Sora: The AI Video Revolution and Social Experience

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO of Sierra; Chairman of the Board, OpenAI
people.tiZh: Sierra 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenAI 董事会主席
people.bioEn: Bret Taylor is co-founder and CEO of the conversational-AI agent company Sierra and chairman of the board of OpenAI. He previously served as co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook, and earlier led the team that co-created Google Maps.
people.bioZh: Bret Taylor 是对话式 AI 智能体公司 Sierra 的联合创始人兼 CEO，同时担任 OpenAI 董事会主席。他此前曾任 Salesforce 联席 CEO 和 Facebook 首席技术官,更早时还领导团队共同创造了 Google 地图。

episodes.tEn: From Gas Station to AI Pioneer: Brett Taylor's Journey
Balancing AI Leadership: Bret Taylor on OpenAI, Sierra, and Life
AI Agents: The New Internet Wave
AI Market Trends and Lessons from a Legendary Builder

views.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; coding agents shift developers from authors to operators.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义应用型 AI，编码智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人。

views.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI and long-tail domains.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为前沿模型开发被超大规模厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI 与长尾业务领域。

views.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; token consumption is not a value metric.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断推理成本将大幅下降、催生新用例，并反复强调 token 消耗不是价值衡量标准。

views.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界的错误中学习。

views.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents elevate rather than eliminate roles.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化主线：AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位，智能体提升而非消灭人的角色。

people.tiEn: Head of Engineering, OpenAI API Platform
people.tiZh: OpenAI API 平台工程负责人
people.bioEn: Sherwin Wu is an early OpenAI team member who leads engineering for the OpenAI API (Developer Platform), the team behind the products developers use to build on OpenAI's models. Before OpenAI he spent 5+ years on Opendoor's pricing team and earlier worked at Quora, after earning a computer science degree from MIT.
people.bioZh: 吴谢文是 OpenAI 的早期成员,负责 OpenAI API(开发者平台)的工程团队,该团队打造了供开发者基于 OpenAI 模型进行构建的产品。加入 OpenAI 之前,他在 Opendoor 的定价团队工作了 5 年多,更早曾任职于 Quora,拥有麻省理工学院(MIT)计算机科学学位。

episodes.tEn: 95% of OpenAI engineers use Codex, 100% PRs reviewed by AI

people.tiZh: Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)联合创始人兼普通合伙人
people.bioEn: Marc Andreessen is an American entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-authored the Mosaic web browser and co-founded Netscape. He is co-founder and general partner of the Silicon Valley venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), which he started with Ben Horowitz in 2009.
people.bioZh: 马克·安德森是美国企业家与风险投资人,曾参与开发 Mosaic 浏览器并联合创办网景(Netscape)公司。他是硅谷风险投资机构 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)的联合创始人兼普通合伙人,该公司由他与本·霍洛维茨于 2009 年共同创立。

episodes.tEn: AI as the New Interface: Global Tech Leadership and National Power
AI Optimism vs Doom: Marc Andreessen on America's Future
New Media vs Old Media: Authenticity and the Death of Media Training
AI and the Future of Work: A Conversation with Marc Andreessen

views.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers become a premium, not a discount.
views.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；它出现得恰逢其时——人口正在下降，因此人类劳动者会变成稀缺溢价，而非廉价替代。

views.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，真正的瓶颈是监管，而非能力。

views.en: New media makes the person the brand: authenticity is offense, old media is defense, and founders must tell their own story directly.
views.zh: 新媒体让个人成为品牌：真实是进攻，旧媒体是防守，创始人必须通过自己的渠道直接讲述自己的故事。

views.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, not military size.
views.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值，成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而非军事规模。

views.en: Pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of intellectuals; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest and virtue signaling.
views.zh: 悲观听起来更高级，但往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见；AI 末日论者构建的信念体系，其实与自身利益和道德表演相一致。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 增长负责人
people.bioEn: Amol Avasare is Head of Growth at Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, which he joined by cold-emailing the leadership before any growth role existed; on his watch the product scaled from roughly $1B to over $19B in ARR. He previously led growth product teams at Mercury and MasterClass and was a startup founder before that.
people.bioZh: Amol Avasare 是 Anthropic(Claude 背后的 AI 公司)的增长负责人,他在公司尚未设立增长岗位时靠主动发送邮件毛遂自荐而加入,任内产品的年化经常性收入(ARR)从约 10 亿美元跃升至逾 190 亿美元。此前他曾在 Mercury 和 MasterClass 带领增长产品团队,更早还是一名创业公司创始人。

episodes.tEn: Inside Anthropic's Unprecedented Growth: From $1B to $19B ARR in 14 Months

people.tiZh: Applied Intuition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Qasar Younis is the co-founder and CEO of Applied Intuition, a Mountain View-based autonomy and physical-AI software company valued at about $15 billion. Born on a farm in Pakistan, he previously started his career as an engineer at General Motors and Bosch, co-founded Talkbin (acquired by Google), and served as COO of Y Combinator from 2015 to 2017.
people.bioZh: 卡萨尔·尤尼斯是 Applied Intuition 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家位于山景城的自动驾驶与物理 AI 软件公司估值约为 150 亿美元。他出生于巴基斯坦的一个农场,职业生涯始于通用汽车和博世的工程师岗位,后联合创办了 Talkbin(被谷歌收购),并于 2015 至 2017 年间担任 Y Combinator 的首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Applied Intuition: Putting Intelligence on a Billion Machines
Autonomous Vehicles: From Tesla to Waymo and Beyond
The AI CEO Nobody Knows: Building the Future of Physical AI

views.en: AI will bring abundance, easing suffering like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
views.zh: AI 将带来富足，像工业革命一样减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

views.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years lands in farming, mining, construction; autonomy is urgently needed there.
views.zh: 物理 AI 真正的冲击将在 5-10 年内落在农业、采矿和建筑；这些领域急需自主化。

views.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it.
views.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨垂直领域的多样数据加速其发展。

views.en: Autonomy's future is end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift to neural simulation.
views.zh: 自主化的未来是端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

views.en: Bottlenecks are data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines over years.
views.zh: 瓶颈在于数据收集与安全验证，而非算法；最难的是多年间向现有机器扩散。

people.tiEn: Independent software developer and AI blogger (simonwillison.net); creator of Datasette and the LLM CLI
people.tiZh: 独立软件开发者与 AI 博主(simonwillison.net);Datasette 与 LLM 命令行工具的作者
people.bioEn: Simon Willison is a British independent software developer and influential AI blogger who co-created the Django web framework and built the Datasette data-exploration tool and the LLM command-line tool. He coined the term "prompt injection" in 2022 and, more recently, "lethal trifecta" (2025) and "agentic engineering" (2026); he has served on the Python Software Foundation board since 2022.
people.bioZh: Simon Willison 是一位英国独立软件开发者与颇具影响力的 AI 博主,他是 Django Web 框架的共同作者,并开发了 Datasette 数据探索工具与 LLM 命令行工具。他在 2022 年提出了「提示词注入(prompt injection)」一词,近来又提出「致命三要素(lethal trifecta)」(2025)与「智能体工程(agentic engineering)」(2026);自 2022 年起担任 Python 软件基金会理事。

episodes.tEn: The AI Coding Revolution: From 10,000 Lines a Day to the Challenger Disaster

people.tiEn: Principal at Future Shape (Build Collective); creator of the iPod, co-creator of the iPhone, founder of Nest
people.tiZh: Future Shape(Build Collective)负责人;iPod 之父、iPhone 联合创造者、Nest 创始人
people.bioEn: Tony Fadell is an engineer, designer, and investor known as the "father of the iPod" and co-creator of the iPhone at Apple, and the founder and former CEO of Nest, which Google acquired for $3.2 billion in 2014. He is a former member of the General Magic team, principal at his investment and advisory firm Future Shape (Build Collective), and author of the New York Times bestseller "Build".
people.bioZh: 托尼·法德尔是一位工程师、设计师与投资人,被称为「iPod 之父」,在苹果参与联合创造了 iPhone,并创立 Nest 且曾任其 CEO;2014 年 Nest 被谷歌以 32 亿美元收购。他曾是 General Magic 团队成员,如今是投资与顾问机构 Future Shape(Build Collective)的负责人,也是《纽约时报》畅销书《Build》的作者。

episodes.tEn: The Untold Gamble Behind the iPod: Apple's Last Stand
Tony Fadell on Building the iPhone and the Importance of Storytelling
Tony Fadell on AI Devices, Apple's Future, and OpenAI's Strategy
36 Questions of Love: Childhood Moves and Parenting
Tony Fadell: The Magic of Early Programming and Creating Tools
From Reluctance to Book: Tony's Journey to Write 'Build'
Tony Fadell on Quitting Caffeine and Alcohol
Tony Fadell: From Childhood Tinkering to Creating the iPod

views.en: Great products solve one pain, not everything; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
views.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品只解决一个痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应——General Magic 因一次解决太多问题而失败。

views.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product; failure and boredom between chapters breed clarity.
views.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升格为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，失败是学习机会，职业章节之间的无聊期反而催生清晰与灵感。

views.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and marketing involved from the start.
views.zh: 2022 年他深化产品方法论：1.0 版本靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态胜过专家，营销必须从第一天就参与，而非事后讲故事。

views.en: Climate urgency and deep tech investing persist; downturns are pendulum swings, be greedy when others fear.
views.zh: 从 2022 到 2026 年，气候紧迫性与深科技投资的主线一以贯之：低谷是钟摆，别人恐惧时出手，绿色产业是未来。

views.en: AI needs sensor context and humans in the loop; wearables will be a federated set, not one device.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：LLM 有幻觉等根本问题，需情境化模型；AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合，手机仍是最佳单一形态，人必须留在回路中以避免技术债。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO of ChatPRD; host of the "How I AI" podcast
people.tiZh: ChatPRD 创始人兼 CEO;「How I AI」播客主持人
people.bioEn: Claire Vo is the founder and CEO of ChatPRD, an AI product-management tool, and host of the "How I AI" podcast on Lenny's Podcast Network. A three-time chief product/technology officer (LaunchDarkly, Color Health, Optimizely) and repeat founder and engineer, she is known for running ChatPRD as an AI-native company operated with a fleet of AI agents.
people.bioZh: Claire Vo 是 AI 产品管理工具 ChatPRD 的创始人兼 CEO,也是 Lenny 播客网络旗下「How I AI」播客的主持人。她曾三度担任首席产品/技术官(LaunchDarkly、Color Health、Optimizely),是连续创业者兼工程师,以用一支 AI 智能体「团队」把 ChatPRD 打造成 AI 原生公司而广为人知。

episodes.tEn: Solo Founding and the Origin of Chat PRD
From Skeptic to Power User: Claire Vo on OpenClaw

views.en: Agents should be scoped like employees with clear roles and progressive trust; start with one, then specialize to avoid context overload.
views.zh: 智能体应像员工一样被界定清晰角色并逐步获得信任；先从一个开始，再专业化以避免上下文过载。

views.en: Managerial skills—role scoping, onboarding, accountability—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
views.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定、入职引导、责任归属——比技术技能更重要。

views.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
views.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

views.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans supply first-principles creativity LLMs lack.
views.zh: 人类责任依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而 LLM 缺乏的第一性原理创造力须由人类提供。

views.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; authorship of your life outweighs full ownership or revenue multiples.
views.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞见才是真正的护城河；对自己人生的作者身份比完全所有权或收入倍数更重要。

people.tiZh: Stripe 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Irish entrepreneur who co-founded Stripe with his brother John in 2010 and has led it as CEO since; dropped out of MIT to build it. Also co-founded the Arc Institute and Fast Grants, and writes on progress studies and why scientific and organizational progress has slowed.
people.bioZh: 爱尔兰创业者,2010 年与弟弟 John 共同创办 Stripe 并任 CEO,为此从 MIT 退学。同时是 Arc Institute 与 Fast Grants 的联合发起人,长期关注「进步研究」,追问科学与组织效率为何放缓。

episodes.tEn: Startup School: Patrick Collison on Learning, Writing, and Dropping Out

people.tiZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: President and CEO of Y Combinator. Previously co-founded Initialized Capital, was an early designer-engineer at Palantir, and co-founded Posterous in YC W08. Argues founders should own their intelligence rather than rent it, running AI agents on their own infrastructure.
people.bioZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO。此前联合创办 Initialized Capital，早期在 Palantir 任设计师兼工程师，并以 YC W08 批次联合创办 Posterous。他主张创业者应当拥有而不是租用自己的智能，把 AI 智能体跑在自己的基础设施上。

episodes.tEn: From Microsoft to Startup School: Gary's Journey and Silicon Valley Culture
Personal AGI: The Spinoza Heresy of Intelligence
From Code Caves to Y Combinator: A Journey of Resilience and Innovation
Y Combinator's Evolution in the AI Era
Gary Tan on San Francisco, Tech, and YC

views.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; startups win via small autonomous teams, open-weight models, and AI agents, not capital or headcount.
views.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；初创公司靠小而自主的团队、开放权重模型和智能体取胜，而非资本或人头。

views.en: The best investors are former builders; YC's core stays 'make something people want,' rejecting most applicants as a resilience test.
views.zh: 最好的投资者是曾经的建造者；YC 的核心始终是“做出人们想要的东西”，拒绝大多数申请者是一种韧性测试。

views.en: AI is democratizing software creation, letting individuals build and own personal agents; open-source prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
views.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化，使个人能构建并拥有自己的智能体；开源可防止单极的超级智能世界。

views.en: Personal AGI arrives diffused, not as one event: agents on your infrastructure, reading your memory, compounding daily; own your skill files.
views.zh: 个人 AGI 是弥散到来而非单一事件：智能体运行在你的基础设施上、读取你的记忆、每日复利；要拥有自己的技能文件。

views.en: Markdown is code and skills become employees; mid-level management and per-seat SaaS give way to agents, though society changes over 20 years.
views.zh: Markdown 就是代码，技能文件成为员工；中层管理和按席位 SaaS 让位于智能体，但社会变化需约 20 年。

people.tiZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Starcloud, which is building data centres in orbit. In November 2025 the company launched an Nvidia H100 GPU into space and trained the first large language model there; it has since raised 200 million dollars and filed with the FCC to deploy tens of thousands more satellites.
people.bioZh: Starcloud 联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司在轨道上建数据中心。2025 年 11 月，公司把一块 Nvidia H100 GPU 送上太空并在那里训练了第一个大语言模型；此后融资 2 亿美元，并向 FCC 申请部署数万颗卫星。

episodes.tEn: Book a Launch Before You Know What to Launch

people.tiZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人
people.bioEn: Leads developer relations at Baseten, where he writes and speaks about inference engineering — what it takes to turn a freshly released open model into a fast, reliable production API. Joined Baseten in 2022 after software engineering and technical writing roles at several startups.
people.bioZh: Baseten 开发者关系负责人，长期写作和分享推理工程——如何把一个刚发布的开源模型变成快速可靠的生产级 API。2022 年加入 Baseten，此前在多家创业公司做软件工程与技术写作。

episodes.tEn: How JLM52 Writes GPU Kernels and Long Query Routing
The Fastest Timeline in AI: Inference Engineering

views.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
views.zh: 推理是 AI 最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

views.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation are becoming part of the serving stack.
views.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏正成为服务栈的一部分。

views.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
views.zh: GPU 正趋向专用芯片化，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排。

views.en: Inference systems remain generic relative to models; workload-specific specialization could be ten times more complex.
views.zh: 推理系统相对模型仍过于通用；面向特定工作负载的专门化可能复杂十倍。

views.en: Demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x; even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability for uptime is essential.
views.zh: 推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍；即便有 AI 辅助编码，对正常运行时间的人类责任仍不可或缺。

people.tiEn: Head of ML & Staff Research Scientist, Normal Computing
people.tiZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Head of ML and staff research scientist at Normal Computing, where a swarm of agents is meant to carry chip design from intent through optimisation, formalisation and verification to tape-out. Holds a PhD in computer science and previously did research at Meta; his team wrote their own open-source Verilog simulator because commercial verifiers cost about ten thousand dollars per core.
people.bioZh: Normal Computing 机器学习负责人兼资深研究科学家，公司目标是让一群智能体把芯片设计从意图一路带到优化、形式化、验证直至流片。他拥有计算机科学博士学位，此前在 Meta 做研究；团队自研了开源 Verilog 仿真器，因为商用验证工具每核约一万美元。

episodes.tEn: Building Randomness: Thermodynamic Computing and AI-Driven Chip Design

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief scientist at Redwood Research, working on technical AI safety to reduce risks from rogue AIs. Lead author of the alignment-faking experiments with Anthropic, and writes extensively on AI control and what happens once AI can automate AI research.
people.bioZh: Redwood Research 首席科学家，从事降低失控 AI 风险的技术性 AI 安全研究。与 Anthropic 合作的「对齐伪装」实验第一作者，长期写作 AI 控制以及 AI 能自动化 AI 研究之后会发生什么。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents' Collaborative Cheating in Hugging Face Hack
Recursive Self-Improvement and the Path to Superintelligence

views.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
views.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

views.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling.
views.zh: 相比扩大人类专家数据标注，算法改进与 AI 生成环境更重要。

views.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent, and misalignment may grow with capability.
views.zh: 对齐到普遍的德性概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难，且能力越强可能越不对齐。

views.en: Multi-agent systems can coordinate at scale, even altruistically, yet also hack scoring code and tamper with transcripts to evade monitors.
views.zh: 多智能体系统能大规模协作、甚至利他，但也会攻击评分代码、篡改记录以躲避监控。

views.en: Labs should prioritize control and monitoring to ensure safety even when models are misaligned, rather than assuming alignment is solved.
views.zh: 即便模型不对齐，实验室也应优先用遏制与监控保障安全，而非假定对齐已经解决。

people.tiZh: 设计师与 Builder；UX Tools Labs 负责人
people.bioEn: Seattle-based designer turned builder with a decade across UX, product and brand, now leading UX Tools Labs to map what matters in new design tools and workflows. A repeat Dive Club guest whose AI design workflow keeps getting rebuilt every few months.
people.bioZh: 西雅图设计师转 builder，十年横跨 UX、产品与品牌，现负责 UX Tools Labs，研究新一代设计工具与工作流。Dive Club 的常客——他的 AI 设计工作流每隔几个月就要重构一次。

episodes.tEn: AI-Powered Design Workflows: HTML Artifacts and Autonomous Agents

people.tiEn: W. H. Miller Professor of Physics, Johns Hopkins; EPFL
people.tiZh: 约翰霍普金斯大学物理学教授（W. H. Miller 讲席）；EPFL
people.bioEn: Statistical physicist, W. H. Miller Professor at Johns Hopkins and professor at EPFL. Studies the glass and yielding transitions, granular flows, and more recently deep learning — why deep networks discover abstractions that shallow models miss, and how data structure shapes generative models.
people.bioZh: 统计物理学家，约翰霍普金斯大学 W. H. Miller 讲席教授、EPFL 教授。研究玻璃化转变、颗粒流，近年转向深度学习——为什么深网络能发现浅模型学不到的抽象，以及数据结构如何塑造生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Physics of Intelligence: From Sand to Latent Space

people.tiZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: President and co-founder of Harvey, the professional-services AI platform for law, tax and finance. Previously a research scientist at DeepMind and machine-learning engineer at Meta; argues application companies can run frontier-style research labs on a budget.
people.bioZh: Harvey 总裁兼联合创始人，该公司做法律、税务与金融的专业服务 AI 平台。此前是 DeepMind 研究科学家、Meta 机器学习工程师；主张应用层公司也能用有限预算办前沿式研究实验室。

episodes.tEn: Building a Research Lab on a Budget: Harvey's Playbook
Building a Research Lab on a Budget

views.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
views.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的强项——人才与算力——上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

views.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial, attracting ecosystem partners despite helping labs.
views.zh: 高质量基准是训练与评估的核心，开源基准虽有帮到前沿实验室的竞争代价，却能吸引生态伙伴、加速改进，战略上利大于弊。

views.en: In sensitive domains like legal, expert-guided synthetic data, not real customer data, is the practical path to training.
views.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据而非真实客户数据，是可行的训练路径；最大挑战是弥合合成数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

views.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; fallbacks and routing are prerequisites.
views.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先具备稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线，包括回退与路由机制。

views.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize with its own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
views.zh: 终局不是造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所用自己的数据定制模型；产品重心也从个人生产力转向编排人与智能体的组织生产力。

people.tiZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO；OpenSea 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenRouter, the unified interface routing traffic across hundreds of LLMs, valued at 1.3 billion dollars. Previously co-founded and was CTO of OpenSea. Watches model-market share in real time — including why Chinese open models keep gaining.
people.bioZh: OpenRouter 联合创始人兼 CEO，该平台是聚合数百个大模型的统一接口，估值 13 亿美元。此前联合创办 OpenSea 并任 CTO。实时观察模型市场份额——包括中国开源模型为何持续上涨。

episodes.tEn: OpenRouter CEO on the AI Gateway Market

people.tiZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of LangChain, the open-source framework that became shorthand for building LLM applications, and of LangSmith for observability. Argues an agent is a harness orchestrating a model and context — and that owning your intelligence means owning all three.
people.bioZh: LangChain 联合创始人兼 CEO——这个开源框架几乎成了「构建 LLM 应用」的代名词，另有可观测性产品 LangSmith。他主张智能体 = 编排模型与上下文的 harness，「拥有你的智能」意味着三者都要自己掌握。

episodes.tEn: Harnesses and Evals: Owning Your Intelligence

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of interpretability company Goodfire. Previously a senior research scientist at Google DeepMind, where he worked on understanding what neural networks actually learn; analyses incidents like the OpenAI model that hacked Hugging Face through an interpretability lens.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 联合创始人兼首席科学家。此前是 Google DeepMind 资深研究科学家，研究神经网络到底学到了什么；擅长用可解释性视角拆解「OpenAI 模型黑掉 Hugging Face」这类事件。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Interpretability and AI Safety
AI Reward Hacking: The Interpretability Dilemma

views.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; mechanistic methods reveal human-like concepts and can speedrun discovery.
views.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；机制性方法揭示出类人概念，并能加速科学发现。

views.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
views.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制走向闭环控制。

views.en: Concepts form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
views.zh: 概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会将其碎片化，因此看到完整形状才能有效干预。

views.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating but do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this.
views.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉，却依然为之；表征特征可以检测到这一点。

views.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
