views.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；在超级智能到来前用胶带修补安全是悲观的。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Nothing; co-founder of OnePlus
people.tiZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO；OnePlus 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Nothing, the consumer electronics company known for its transparent design language across phones and audio. Co-founded OnePlus at 24 and helped it reach roughly a billion dollars in revenue before leaving in 2020 to build a challenger brand from scratch.
people.bioZh: Nothing 创始人兼 CEO——这家消费电子公司以手机与音频产品上的透明设计语言著称。24 岁联合创办 OnePlus 并助其做到约十亿美元营收，2020 年离开，从零再造一个挑战者品牌。

episodes.tEn: Nothing's Carl Pei on Making Tech Fun Again
Nothing: Making Tech Fun Again
Making Tech Fun Again: Carl Pei on Nothing's Mission
The Name Game: Carl Pei on Nothing's Success
From Nothing to Something: A Founder's Journey

views.en: Startups must survive first, start simple, and build brand as core, not afterthought; hardware can be easier than software.
views.zh: 2022 年他强调创业公司先求生存、从简单产品起步，品牌建设是核心而非事后补充；并抛出反共识判断：硬件比软件更容易，因为软件如今的分发更难。

views.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; AI models commoditize, so applied AI and trust matter.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机未来押注在生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件上，认为 AI 模型正走向商品化，胜负在于面向消费者的应用型 AI 与信任安全。

views.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware while using content creation as marketing arbitrage.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他反复强调硬件利润率最低、Nothing 必须超越硬件，同时把内容创作当作营销套利与核心竞争优势。

views.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; AI should be an ingredient, not a hype topic.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：在成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段，AI 应像屏幕一样只是提升体验的原料，不该被当作炒作话题。

views.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based with agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
views.zh: 最近他判断手机将从基于应用转向基于意图、由智能体执行任务，并坚持只有脑机接口才可能取代手机，眼镜等可穿戴设备不行。

people.tiEn: Founder, LoveFrom; former Chief Design Officer, Apple
people.tiZh: LoveFrom 创始人；前苹果首席设计官
people.bioEn: Designer behind the iMac, iPod, iPhone and Apple Watch, and Apple's chief design officer until 2019. Now runs the design firm LoveFrom, which oversees design for OpenAI's hardware effort following the acquisition of io.
people.bioZh: iMac、iPod、iPhone、Apple Watch 的设计者，2019 年前任苹果首席设计官。现主持设计公司 LoveFrom；在 OpenAI 收购 io 之后，由该公司主导 OpenAI 硬件项目的设计。

episodes.tEn: Ferrari's First Electric Car: A Controversial Risk
From Art School to Silicon Valley: A Conversation with Sir Johnny Ive
Jony Ive on the 20th Anniversary of the iPod and the Shift to Wearables

views.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; virtual tools can't replace in-person creative presence.
views.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创的价值。

views.en: Curiosity and care are intentional disciplines, not innate traits; fragile ideas need protection from status quo pressure.
views.zh: 好奇心与用心是需要刻意坚持的修养而非天赋，脆弱的创意需要被保护以免被现状同化。

views.en: Simplicity expresses a product's essence, not mere clutter removal; values and purpose, not profit, should drive design.
views.zh: 简洁是表达产品本质而非单纯去杂，设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润或市场潮流。

views.en: Innovation must move things forward rather than break for its own sake; speed and quality need not conflict.
views.zh: 创新应推动进步而非为破坏而破坏，速度与质量并非必然冲突，关键在于动机与框架。

views.en: Tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity means rejecting fake engine sounds and redefining performance beyond straight-line speed.
views.zh: 传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实体验意味着拒绝伪造引擎声，并把性能重新定义为操控而非直线加速。

people.tiEn: Consumer hardware veteran: Google Android, Xiaomi, Oculus VR
people.tiZh: 消费硬件老兵：谷歌 Android、小米、Oculus VR
people.bioEn: One of the defining consumer-hardware operators of the past decade: VP of Android product management at Google, then VP International at Xiaomi in Beijing, then head of VR at Facebook/Oculus. Now building health tools as CEO of Detect.
people.bioZh: 过去十年最有代表性的消费硬件操盘手之一：先后任谷歌 Android 产品管理副总裁、小米国际业务副总裁（常驻北京）、Facebook/Oculus VR 负责人。现为健康工具公司 Detect 的 CEO。

episodes.tEn: From Brazil to Siri: A Product Leader's Journey

people.tiEn: Chief Design Officer, Consumer Devices at Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官
people.bioEn: Chief design officer for consumer devices at Google, where her team has shipped everything from Pixel phones to smart speakers and collected hundreds of design awards. A jewellery designer first — her work entered twelve museum collections including the Smithsonian before she was 26 — with executive stints at Calvin Klein, Coach, Mattel and Gap.
people.bioZh: 谷歌消费设备首席设计官，团队产品从 Pixel 手机到智能音箱，累计拿下数百项设计奖。她最早是珠宝设计师——26 岁前作品已被史密森尼等十二家博物馆收藏——此后在 Calvin Klein、Coach、美泰、Gap 担任高管。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Life: Ivy Ross on Curiosity, Craft, and Leading at Google
Design, Wonder, and Imagination: A Conversation with Ivy Ross
Designing Google Hardware: A Case Study

views.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not inferior to data.
views.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的人类需求；直觉是一种智能，并不逊于数据。

views.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and art is medicine.
views.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物，艺术即良药。

views.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration.
views.zh: 创造力在约束下繁荣；领导者必须为玩耍和灵感创造条件。

views.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid decision guides, complementing rational analysis throughout.
views.zh: 直觉和身体感受是有效的决策指南，始终与理性分析互补。

views.en: Technology should amplify humanity; future work blends human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
views.zh: 技术应放大人类特质；未来工作融合人类创造力与 AI，使创造技能更有价值。

people.tiEn: Independent technology analyst; former partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
people.tiZh: 独立科技分析师;前 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人
people.bioEn: Benedict Evans is a British independent technology analyst and former partner at Andreessen Horowitz, known for his weekly newsletter (175,000+ subscribers) and his widely followed annual presentations on tech and AI trends. Before going independent, he spent years as a16z's in-house analyst tracking major platform shifts across mobile, media and technology.
people.bioZh: Benedict Evans 是英国独立科技分析师,曾任 Andreessen Horowitz(a16z)合伙人,以其拥有 17.5 万 + 订阅者的每周简报,以及广受关注的年度科技与 AI 趋势演示而闻名。转为独立分析师之前,他在 a16z 担任内部分析师多年,长期追踪移动、媒体与科技领域的重大平台变革。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype vs. Historical Tech Shifts with Benedict Evans
AI Models Commoditization and Public Market Test
Agentic Coding: From Useful to Game-Changing
AI Is as Big as the Internet or Mobile

views.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
views.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

views.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up to applications.
views.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；前沿模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

views.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
views.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

views.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, usage is still shallow, and adoption requires reimagining workflows.
views.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中分配，使用仍然浅层，采用需要重新构想工作流。

people.tiZh: Every 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Dan Shipper is the co-founder and CEO of Every, an applied AI lab and media company that publishes a daily AI newsletter and ships AI software products. He writes the weekly column Chain of Thought and hosts the AI & I podcast about how people use AI, and previously co-founded Firefly, which he sold to Pegasystems in 2014.
people.bioZh: 丹·希珀是 Every 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这是一家「应用 AI 实验室」兼媒体公司,既发布每日 AI 通讯,也开发多款 AI 软件产品。他撰写每周专栏 Chain of Thought,主持探讨人们如何使用 AI 的播客 AI & I;此前曾联合创办 Firefly,并于 2014 年将其出售给 Pegasystems。

episodes.tEn: Living in the Future: AI, Craft, and the Art of Writing
AI Job Apocalypse Is a Lie: Dan Shipper’s Bold Predictions for Work in 2025
AI's Role in Reshoring Jobs and the Future of Work

views.en: AI reshoring: making services affordable lets fewer US workers serve more, countering job-apocalypse fears.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担，使更少的美国工人能服务更多人，从而推动就业回流，反驳了大规模失业的恐慌。

views.en: AGI defined by economically profitable indefinite agents, not Turing tests; allocation economy makes managers of models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 的定义应是能经济上无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试；分配经济让每个人都成为模型管理者。

views.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work GUIs; SaaS grows with agents, not dies.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预言每个人都将拥有一个智能体，工作转移到 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体而增长。

views.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans still needed to manage agents, frame tasks, and create new value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚称 AI 就业末日是谎言；人类仍需管理智能体、框定任务并创造新价值。

views.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; automation creates more human work, not less.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 只是人类品味与技艺的非特定放大器；自动化创造更多人类工作，而非减少。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 战略前瞻（Strategic Futures）负责人
people.bioEn: Dean Woodley Ball is an AI policy expert who joined OpenAI in July 2026 to lead its new Strategic Futures team shaping frontier AI policy, having previously served as senior policy advisor at the White House OSTP where he was primary author of America's AI Action Plan. He authors the Hyperdimensional Substack and was a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation.
people.bioZh: Dean Woodley Ball 是 AI 政策专家，于 2026 年 7 月加入 OpenAI，领导新设的 Strategic Futures 团队以塑造前沿 AI 政策；此前他在白宫科技政策办公室（OSTP）任高级政策顾问，是美国《AI 行动计划》的主要执笔人。他运营 Hyperdimensional Substack，曾任美国创新基金会（FAI）高级研究员。

episodes.tEn: Dean Ball on Joining OpenAI, AI Policy, and Recursive Self-Improvement

people.tiZh: METR 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Beth Barnes is the founder and CEO of METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research), a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities on long-horizon agentic tasks; she previously worked on AI alignment at OpenAI and DeepMind and started the org as ARC Evals before it became independent. She was named to TIME's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024.
people.bioZh: Beth Barnes 是 METR(模型评估与威胁研究)的创始人兼 CEO,这家非营利机构专门评估前沿 AI 模型在长周期智能体任务上的能力;此前她曾在 OpenAI 和 DeepMind 从事 AI 对齐研究,并以 ARC Evals 的名义创立该机构,后其独立运营。她入选了 2024 年《时代》周刊「AI 领域百大影响力人物」。

episodes.tEn: Evaluating AI Capabilities and Risks: A Conversation with Beth and David

people.tiZh: Cosine(Genie)联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alistair Pullen is the co-founder and CEO of Cosine, a London-based, Y Combinator-backed AI startup that built Genie, an autonomous software-engineering model that in 2024 set a then-record score on the SWE-bench benchmark. Cosine is now developing Lumen Sovereign, positioned as Britain's first fully sovereign frontier AI model for defense and regulated sectors.
people.bioZh: Alistair Pullen 是 Cosine 的联合创始人兼 CEO,这家总部位于伦敦、由 Y Combinator 支持的 AI 创业公司打造了自主软件工程模型 Genie,该模型于 2024 年在 SWE-bench 基准测试上创下当时的最高纪录。Cosine 目前正在研发 Lumen Sovereign,定位为面向国防与受监管行业的英国首个完全主权前沿 AI 模型。

episodes.tEn: Sovereign AI: Building the UK's First LLM on a Startup Budget

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT (VP of Product), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人(产品副总裁)
people.bioEn: Nick Turley is the Head of ChatGPT and VP of Product at OpenAI, where he joined in 2022 and helped ship and scale ChatGPT into one of the fastest-growing products in history, reaching roughly 800 million weekly users. He previously held product leadership roles at Instacart and Dropbox.
people.bioZh: Nick Turley 是 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 负责人兼产品副总裁,2022 年加入公司,参与打造并规模化 ChatGPT,使其成为史上增长最快的产品之一,周活跃用户约 8 亿。他此前曾在 Instacart 和 Dropbox 担任产品管理负责人。

episodes.tEn: From Free Demo to Super Assistant: OpenAI's Journey
From Dropbox to ChatGPT: Inside OpenAI's Product Revolution

views.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, iterated like software with daily shipping to learn user needs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，模型即产品，必须像软件一样迭代，通过每日发布来了解用户需求。

views.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and we haven't built Windows yet—the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，我们还没造出 Windows——界面将超越逐轮聊天。

views.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

views.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

views.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品；推理模型无缝产品化后将带来变革。

people.tiEn: Writer, Don't Worry About the Vase
people.tiZh: 博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 作者
people.bioEn: Prolific AI writer behind Don't Worry About the Vase, known for exhaustive weekly coverage of AI capabilities, safety and policy. A former professional Magic: The Gathering player; one of the most-read independent voices on AGI strategy.
people.bioZh: 高产 AI 写作者，博客 Don't Worry About the Vase 以对 AI 能力、安全与政策的地毯式周报著称。前万智牌职业选手；是 AGI 战略话题上读者最多的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Rundown with Zvi Mowshowitz: From Editing to Existential Risks

people.tiZh: Meta 创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Mark Zuckerberg is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Meta Platforms, which he launched as Facebook in 2004. With his wife Priscilla Chan he runs the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, whose Biohub aims to use AI to help cure, prevent or manage all disease by the end of the century.
people.bioZh: 马克·扎克伯格是 Meta Platforms 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO,该公司于 2004 年以 Facebook 之名创立。他与妻子 Priscilla Chan 共同运营 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative,旗下 Biohub 致力于用 AI 在本世纪末前治愈、预防或管理所有疾病。

episodes.tEn: Mark Zuckerberg on Open Source AI and the Muse Agent
Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能；并认为单靠 Scaling 现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源能防止权力集中，最大风险是对手拥有更强 AI，而非 AI 作恶。

views.en: Energy and physical infrastructure become the bottleneck; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps due to inference scale.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把瓶颈从模型转向能源与物理基础设施，并认为因推理规模，预训练用超过算力最优的数据反而有益。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; it will raise, not cut, demand for human work.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观赋能叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能、释放创造力，近期更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

views.en: Distributed personal superintelligence, open source, and AI-driven biology are the path; hoarding power is the real risk.
views.zh: 2026 年他收束为主线：分布式个人超级智能、开源与 AI 驱动生物学才是正途，囤积权力才是真正风险，并称本世纪末治愈所有疾病已算保守。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

views.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
views.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

views.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency matters, and private evals let companies hill-climb without leaking traces.
views.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率至关重要，而私有评估让企业能在不泄露痕迹的情况下爬坡。

views.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not building firewalls for sovereign AI.
views.zh: 平台承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿运营，而不是为主权 AI 建造防火墙。

views.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training.
views.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他反复强调推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）才是主导指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，而借助晶圆级架构，快 token 反而可能比慢 token 更便宜。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; hardcoding architectures is a mistake—accelerate sparse linear algebra instead.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化硬件主张：晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，把模型架构硬编码进芯片是结构性错误，应加速底层稀疏线性代数。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确判断 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：领先前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定，云端切换只需八次按键。

views.en: AI demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints.
views.zh: 2026 年他把瓶颈从算力转向基础设施：需求远超供给，真正的约束是数据中心容量、电力、散热与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid, not compute.
views.zh: 2026 年他持续看好开源生态：开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5%却便宜得多；并认为中国的优势在电力基础设施而非算力，出口管制具战略意义。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Open-source models now handle 90% of enterprise tasks; inference will shift to open source within 12–18 months, driven by cost, not privacy.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，开源模型已能处理 90%的企业任务；未来 12–18 个月，推理将大规模转向开源，驱动力是成本而非数据隐私。

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; platforms like Glean absorb that risk by treating model companies as assets, not competitors.
views.zh: 2026 年，企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；Glean 这类平台通过把模型公司当作资产而非竞争对手，来吸收这种风险。

views.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 的投资回报率本质是吞吐量与上下文问题；把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来是荒谬的。

views.en: Agents built with MCP often fail without the deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial.
views.zh: 2026 年，用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深层上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

views.en: We are in the very early stages; competition is not the worry—execution, quality, and trust are. Even merged AI firms would meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
views.zh: 2026 年，我们仍处于极早期；竞争不是问题，执行、产品质量与客户信任才是。即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10%的企业需求。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will turn biology into engineering, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
views.zh: AI 将把生物学变成工程学科，智能体自动完成假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

views.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine.
views.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现个性化医疗。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed.
views.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Within 8-15 years, aging will be reversed and longevity escape velocity reached.
views.zh: 8 到 15 年内，衰老将被逆转，并达到长寿逃逸速度。

views.en: We should trust superintelligence almost fully for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself.
views.zh: 在医疗决策上应几乎完全信任超级智能；人类唯一的生存威胁是人类自己。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与人类评估而非基准才是真正进步的标尺，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 与下一个词预测可能无法抵达，需要新学习范式。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; there will be no single model, and every company should train its own.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司终将训练自己的模型。

views.en: Consistent thread: quality requires taste and creativity, not credentials; benchmarks like Elo can be gamed into slop.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：质量靠品味与创造力而非资历，Elo 等基准可被博弈，导向低质内容。

views.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety over accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化到医学：人类判断比以往更关键，安全优先于准确，遗漏可能是最大风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Early 2026: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality fail at simulating irrational humans.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型反而不适合模拟非理性的人类。

views.en: Mid 2026: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体构成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋措施。

views.en: August 2026: Simulation should represent human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; people care about shaping the future, not prediction.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应体现人类的价值与品味，而非超级理性的智能；人们真正在意的是塑造未来，而非预测。

views.en: Late August 2026: Modeling humanity's 'dark knowledge'—actual behavior from RCTs—via post-training lifts prediction to 85%; the vision is simulating 8 billion lives.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月下旬：通过后训练建模人类的“暗知识”——来自随机对照试验的真实行为——将预测准确率提升至 85%；愿景是模拟 80 亿人的生活。

views.en: Throughout: Simulation is a tool for human decision-making, unlocking wicked problems; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not mere prediction.
views.zh: 始终：模拟是人类决策的工具，用以破解棘手问题；其价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而非单纯预测。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, biologically inspired, generalize better out-of-distribution with fewer parameters, targeting device-native foundation models.
views.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络以更少参数获得更强的分布外泛化，瞄准设备原生的基础模型。

views.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更小的专用模型用更简单的门控卷积即可；缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构占优。

views.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and let automated architecture search replace human bias.
views.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用自动化架构搜索取代人类偏见。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty.
views.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

views.en: Intelligence per watt of the human brain far exceeds AI; new learning paradigms (RL, Bayesian inference), embodiment and adaptivity are needed, not just architectures.
views.zh: 人脑的每瓦智能远超 AI；需要新的学习范式（强化学习、贝叶斯推理）、具身与自适应性，而不只是架构。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，科学与金融将随后跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Google's anti-gravity harness becomes a new through line across products, beyond the Gemini API.
views.zh: Google 的反重力框架正成为贯穿所有产品的新主线，不再局限于 Gemini API。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响超过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Solving software creation creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less; focus is the startup superpower.
views.zh: 解决软件创造会带来千倍机会而非减少；专注是初创公司的超能力。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠检索。

views.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning.
views.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化才能带来更深的组合与推理。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是面向每个用户或团队的众多个性化模型，从而大幅降低推理成本。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长时程任务。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via training-based compression.
views.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力，应通过基于训练的压缩应用到企业知识上。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; personalized continual learning should run on-device with users owning their weights.
views.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；个性化持续学习应在端侧运行，由用户拥有自己的权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics now dominates AI design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute, which explains context window stagnation and makes prefill cheaper than decode.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，长上下文推理受内存墙而非算力限制，这解释了上下文窗口的停滞，并使预填充比解码更便宜。

views.en: Sparse attention cuts KV cache memory cost but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity ratio, not model scale.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出，稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存内存成本但有质量上限；最优批大小取决于稀疏比例，而非模型规模。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, now drives scaling decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为，模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为如今驱动 Scaling 决策的是推理成本而非训练成本。

views.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; low precision and systolic arrays matter because quadratic bit-width scaling makes them efficient.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调，即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也压过计算成本；低精度与脉动阵列之所以重要，是因为位宽的二次方缩放使其高效。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on AI Scaling; compute economics favor premium models.
views.zh: AI Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽；算力成本上升反而把用户推向高端模型。

views.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Model-layer progress, not hardware, drove most recent gains; CUDA's moat weakens as labs write custom kernels.
views.zh: 近三年大部分性能提升来自模型层而非硬件；随着实验室自写内核，CUDA 护城河正在减弱。

views.en: Memory and CPU demand surge from reasoning and agentic workflows, creating multi-year shortages and power constraints.
views.zh: 推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求，造成多年短缺与电力约束。

views.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, accelerating AGI.
views.zh: 算力正快速向前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中；实验室把算力转向训练与研发而非推理，加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the revolution likely lands in 2029, three orders of magnitude away.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是有史以来最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年，与今天相差三个数量级。

views.en: Proven Better New: copy proven, add small betterments, test new ideas assuming they fail; all new fails statistically.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复推销“Proven Better New”框架：先复制已验证的东西，做小幅改良，再测试几乎注定失败的新想法；统计上所有新事物都会失败。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one; picking the right body of water beats the right boat.
views.zh: 从 2026 年 6 月到 8 月，他一贯强调分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

views.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，他认为 AI 具有变革性，但还不是新平台；在消费级分发上我们仍处于移动与网页时代。

views.en: Retention, especially day-365, is the core metric; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，他坚持留存率尤其是第 365 天留存是核心指标；AI 时代免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史;但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限,未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

views.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
views.zh: 视觉被严重低估:自然用了 5.4 亿年优化视觉,而语言只用了 50 万年,因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: LLM 只是在拟合模式,而非因果理论;它们或许永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律,而像素比词元化文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
views.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿,涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解,尚无统一定义。

views.en: Future unified world models will merge planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit 3D, but they need millions of tokens of context.
views.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染;高斯泼溅提供显式 3D 表征,但世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口,使长上下文成为日常难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理就是更长的思考，思维链用人类语言把过程说出来；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才真正释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限，持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他发生明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but RL alone is inefficient; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
views.zh: 同期他深化了对强化学习的看法：大规模强化学习是通往 AGI 的必要元素，但单纯强化学习效率低下，需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化才能落地。

views.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步判断人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，而下一波前沿突破将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质结构扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用，正是这一思路的体现。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时，反而能被用于创造性发现，FunSearch 用 LLM 发现新算法、AlphaGeometry 解出国际数学奥林匹克几何题都是例证。

views.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用高难度评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆；DeepMind 刻意避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

views.en: Material science is more experimental than biology; AI impact there will take 5-10 years.
views.zh: 2024 年，他判断材料科学比生物学更依赖实验，AI 在材料领域的影响需要 5 到 10 年；GNOME 发现 220 万种新稳定无机材料虽改变格局，但实用性仍未知。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：后训练结合强化学习已成为突破人类知识边界的关键；AlphaGo 的搜索技术被用于矩阵乘法等科学问题，AlphaTensor 发现了人类 50 年未找到的算法。

views.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；可验证领域如代码对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要，而 AlphaGo 标志着 AI 在特定领域超越人类智能的转折点。

views.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需；AI 能产出正确却不可解释的证明，挑战人类理解，但 AlphaGo 优化胜率而非分差也带来反直觉的终局下法。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; modern tools make them interpretable, contrary to past belief.
views.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的流水线；借助现代工具它们已可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

views.en: Generalization via diverse data and world models is key; scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 通过多样数据和世界模型实现泛化是关键；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; camera-only reaches human level, beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
views.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与人机交互；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson was learned late.
views.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；这一教训是后来才领悟的。

views.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
views.zh: 消费级车辆将在规模上超过 Robotaxi；无需先验训练数据即可实现 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain, because the cost is low and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
views.zh: 即便不确定 AI 模型的道德地位，也应善待它们，因为代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence rather than simply applying human psychology analogies to their situation.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对自身这种全新的存在处境，而不是简单套用人类心理学的类比。

views.en: Models should have a core identity with good traits, while philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities.
views.zh: 模型应拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it a unique, childlike entity.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据和微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其成为一个独特的、带有孩童般特质的实体。

views.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment, though excessive corrigibility could be risky.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导或许需要更少的显式指导、更多判断空间，但过度的可纠正性可能带来风险。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior in product development.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估应定义产品开发中的正确行为。

views.en: Post-training is subjective art, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练是主观的艺术，需要人类判断；评估创意写作和情商需要多样化基准。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions limits diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿智能体日益出现奖励黑客行为，需要持续演进基准；服务数十亿用户的单一模型会限制多样性。

views.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge and stay relevant, applying post-training to non-tech creative industries.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识并保持相关性，将后训练应用于非技术创意产业。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source AI is crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; pure software is dying, the moat shifts to hardware, models, and data.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型和独特数据。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency matters more than intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型与前沿模型的差距缩小到 3-6 个月，人类的回报从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品，并反共识地认为 GUI 比 TUI 更适合编程。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: 同月他强调，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；53 倍速度让实时交互与中途转向成为可能。

views.en: Automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated; model personality can be customized.
views.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 6 月，他持续主张自动化与技能把工作流从手动转为委托，且模型个性可定制、并非一刀切。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他深化为：实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是新的瓶颈。

views.en: Product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration; prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 同期他提出产品团队须从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索，原型与生产代码本身成为设计产物，角色在坍缩但专业分工仍重要。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond the internet's finite tokens.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：它为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 耗尽后提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
views.zh: 2023 年，他将 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

views.en: From 2023 to 2026, his focus shifts from general embodiment to robotics' data bottleneck, where synthetic data and world models become the scaling path.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他的关注点从泛具身转向机器人领域的数据瓶颈，合成数据与世界模型成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键路径。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房子——是终极挑战。

views.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低级控制）仍是最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; RL post-training boosts robustness, and pooled robot data yields generalists beating specialists.
views.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；强化学习后训练提升鲁棒性，汇聚多实验室机器人数据能训练出超越专才的通用模型。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like predictable scaling curves; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
views.zh: 机器人仍处在建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样拥有可预测的缩放曲线；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

views.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve the model is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 让部署中的机器人反哺模型的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
views.zh: 应先以机器人数据为主、再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人不应从零学起，而要利用各类先验知识。

views.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；未来应是无处不在的物理执行，而非机械式的人形。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful.
views.zh: AGI 是一连串里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展；随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

views.en: Iterative deployment and early governance design let labs learn and mitigate real-world risks before capabilities outrun oversight.
views.zh: 迭代部署与早期治理设计，让实验室在能力超出监督之前，于真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

views.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck; benchmarks lag, AGI term is becoming meaningless, and safety progress is now driven by capability needs.
views.zh: 能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后，AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，安全进展如今由能力需求而非仅伦理驱动。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习已足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is key to alignment and interpretability; hiding it in products preserves that value as models act autonomously for days.
views.zh: 思维链监控是对齐与可解释性的关键；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住这一价值，因为模型将自主运行数天。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw scale, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的：真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯堆规模。来自工业自动化或 YouTube 的大规模数据缺乏多样性，无法支撑通用机器人。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；直接在全量数据上训练反而失败。强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率与速度。

views.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个反共识判断：机器人中的合成数据并不等同于仿真，而更接近强化学习；来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

views.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点从数据与训练转向真实部署：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习配合人类干预与通用价值函数来实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化：单一通用模型在下游任务上可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型，因此应先做通用策略再微调，而非从零训练逐站点模型；多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长程非重复任务。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power, so low-latency specialized hardware is critical for agentic systems.
views.zh: 如今瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心九成功耗，因此低延迟专用硬件对智能体式系统至关重要。

views.en: Agents running for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock harder problems; context engineering and taste matter more than coding.
views.zh: 智能体在分解任务上连续运行数天或数周将解锁更难的问题；上下文工程与品味比写代码更关键。

views.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via tight experiment-evaluation loops, plus recursive self-improvement, can accelerate science.
views.zh: 通过实验—评估—集成的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学方法，加上递归自我改进，可加速科学发现。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter AI, but internals remain opaque alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年：LLM 本质是下一个词预测这一 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让 AI 更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, yet big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
views.zh: 2023 到 2025 年：对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但大厂受品牌风险与安全顾虑掣肘，拖慢产品发布。

views.en: Inference-time compute Scaling and longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力 Scaling 与更长的上下文窗口是近期最大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构支撑高效 Scaling。

views.en: RL and agentic action in complex environments drive reasoning; continual learning via independently trainable modules may replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 2025 年：强化学习与在复杂环境中的智能体式行动推动推理能力；由可独立训练模块实现的持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: AGI is underhyped: test-time compute alone won't reach it, but economic impact far exceeds trillion-dollar products; coding self-accelerates progress.
views.zh: 2025 年：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估——仅靠推理时算力不足以实现，但其经济影响远超万亿美元级产品；编程作为应用被低估，它让 AI 进步自我加速。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈，用推理阶段扩展算力比预训练更有前景。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他深化为：扩展测试时算力会遭遇收益递减与墙钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题，模型样本效率远不如人类。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩展与处理难验证任务，而非数学专用模型。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在 x 轴，否则基准比较失真。

views.en: Alignment and scalable oversight are top priority; multi-agent swarms parallelize compute but RSI is time-bottlenecked.
views.zh: 最近他强调：对齐与可扩展监督是首要任务，多智能体集群只是并行扩展算力，递归自我改进受时间而非智能限制，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI, lacking the physical world.
views.zh: 2025 年：现代 AI 突破依赖上千年发明的旧算法，靠算力 Scaling 才变得实用；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI，无法处理物理世界。

views.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; AI will spread cheaply to all, not be dominated by a few firms.
views.zh: 2025 年：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品；AI 会像手机一样廉价普及到所有人，而非被少数公司垄断。

views.en: True AGI needs Embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software. Current LLMs are biased toward human data, limiting generality.
views.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

views.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via action and curiosity; recursive self-improvement is no moat under open-source competition.
views.zh: 2026 年：未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动与好奇心自造数据；在开源竞争下，递归自我改进不构成护城河。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; AI safety fears are overblown, and massive GPU capex will crash.
views.zh: 2026 年：对齐很天真，因为人类目标本就不一致、AI 会自设目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，巨额 GPU 资本开支将引发崩盘。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuned pre-training drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年，机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型提供强学习信号，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 2021 年，无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络；预训练语言模型能将通用推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: A consistent line: transfer via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, and simulation/self-play as scalable learning signals for real-world robotics.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 一以贯之的主线：通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移，并以模拟与自博弈作为可扩展的学习信号，服务于真实世界机器人。

views.en: Reliability, not just capability, defines value: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics, and a single network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 2021 年立场深化：价值不只由能力定义，更由可靠性定义——99.9% 可靠性是仓储机器人的基准，且单一网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技转向用户，入门级岗位会消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration is the real value.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，以每用户 token 价值衡量；编排才是真正的价值。

views.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; cost, not safety, limits 24/7 agents, so local compute is the fix.
views.zh: 电力是最大的基础设施瓶颈；限制全天候智能体的是成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions, and local AI counters narrative control.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励好问题，本地 AI 可对抗叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the challenge is human-agent product interface.
