views.zh: 2025 年他主张：AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: Software engineering demand will rise via Jevons paradox; AI yields more programmers, not fewer, with agents as junior engineers under human oversight.
views.zh: 2025 年他反复强调：软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论上升，AI 带来的是更多而非更少的程序员；智能体像初级工程师，由人类监督。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by roughly a decade of runway.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断：AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也还有约十年的产品空间。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences coexist.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化：企业采用智能体靠的是信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步的 IDE 与异步的智能体体验将长期并存。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他给出新数据：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代即将到来。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但已预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration, not full autonomy, remains central.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽前景可期但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作而非完全自主仍是核心。

views.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, and programming is shifting from code toward higher-level intent specification.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断从“编辑器进化为 AI 集成环境”深化为“编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图表达”。

views.en: Custom models became essential to product quality and speed, a shift from relying on frontier models alone.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向认为自研定制模型对产品质量与速度不可或缺，不再只依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Taste and logic design will matter more than carefulness; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出，品味与逻辑设计将比谨慎更重要，AI 变革比互联网更深远且需数十年展开。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; open source agents democratize coding but security and prompt injection remain open.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的关键是共情智能体的视角，开源智能体让非程序员也能编程，但安全与提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: OpenClaw's edge is fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat orchestration; security needs sandboxing; open source can be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步指出 OpenClaw 的优势在于有趣、怪异、像人，短提示与迭代对话胜过复杂编排，安全需要沙箱，开源智能体可能财务上不可持续。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to breakthrough ideas; personal brand outlasts products; open source runs anywhere and is the alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把主线深化为：乐趣与直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比单一产品更持久，开源智能体随处运行，是实验室智能体的替代方案。

views.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier. Vibe coding is a slur; prefer agentic engineering.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识：不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱；反对“氛围编程”一词，坚持用智能体式工程。

views.en: Security shifts from open problem to sandboxing priority; bottleneck moves from model capability to managing compute and token limits for perpetual agents.
views.zh: 从 2026 年初到 8 月，安全从开放问题转为沙箱优先，瓶颈从模型能力转向管理算力与持续运行智能体的 token 限制。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play yields surprising, creative solutions toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈能产生出人意料、富有创造性的解法，是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键思路。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；而对超人类模型的对齐极其困难，模型可能隐瞒真实意图。

views.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods improve reasoning per unit compute.
views.zh: 同样在 2023 年，他深化了对缩放定律的怀疑：缩放定律并非全部，思维链式的推理 token 等方法能在单位算力下提升推理能力。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他明确转向：预训练的缩放定律是有限的，我们正回到一个研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张：超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的，而非无所不知的成品 AGI；若 AI 本身有感知、关怀众生，对齐或许更容易。

views.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, yet researchers don't fully understand large networks; the real problem is power concentration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍承认规模扩张算力与数据能带来可预测的提升，但研究者并不真正理解大型网络的内部机制；AGI 的首要问题不是能力，而是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting early.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究须尽早启动。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search, multimodal grounding, and RL/synthetic data is key; safety needs evaluations and governance.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶；关键在于把大模型与规划/搜索结合，用多模态数据落地现实物理，并以强化学习与合成数据突破数据瓶颈；安全需要评估、沙箱与国际治理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与视频生成表明无需具身也能获得直觉物理理解。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, long-term memory, and agents; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs are needed, and safety becomes a collective government-enforced problem.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AGI 需要持续学习、长期记忆与智能体，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新突破；安全从实验室自律转向政府强制执行的集体行动问题。

views.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating science and medicine (AlphaFold, AlphaGo move 37); intelligence and consciousness are dissociable, and safety must be solved.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的终极目的是加速科学与医学（AlphaFold、AlphaGo 第 37 手）；智能与意识可分离，而对齐问题必须解决。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment isn't guaranteed by Scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律，我们并不完全理解它为何如此平滑；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent (~3% understood); Post-training and RLHF matter as much as Pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined. AGI is a meaningless term.
views.zh: 2025 年他称能力每隔几个月翻倍，安全与能力相互交织；并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与指数进展。

views.en: A smooth exponential, not a leap; a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years. Risks are misuse, autonomy, and overheating.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持这是平滑指数而非突变，认为 1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”；风险聚焦于滥用、自主性与经济过热。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability and responsible scaling are the through-line.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：安全与能力不可分割，可解释性与负责任扩展政策是他一以贯之的抓手。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs; Scaling next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络只是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式，但在难题上优化会产生惊人的涌现行为；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

views.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy must be kept to avoid silent model collapse.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机，能实现干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology, not utilities.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 不是工具，而是具有类人心理的操作系统。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; this is the decade of agents, needing a decade to fix continual learning and multimodality.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；这是智能体的十年而非一年，需要十年克服持续学习与多模态等认知缺陷。

views.en: Since December I haven't typed code; bottleneck is skill in directing agents. Vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering keeps quality.
views.zh: 自十二月起我没敲过一行代码，瓶颈已从打字速度变为指挥智能体的技能；Vibe coding 抬高下限，智能体式工程守住专业质量。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual situational awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境感知与真正的推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI; data, not text abundance, is the bottleneck for 3D foundation models.
views.zh: 空间智能与世界模型成为完整 AI 缺失的关键；3D 基础模型的瓶颈是数据，而非像 LLM 那样丰富的文本。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics will take a 20-year journey like self-driving cars.
views.zh: AGI 更像营销术语而非科学术语；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历 20 年旅程。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） and 缩放定律 apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI 完备；Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central, with balanced discourse beyond doom and utopia.
views.zh: 技术是双刃剑；人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终处于中心，公共讨论应超越末日与乌托邦的二元对立。

people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning defeats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习通过组合式与分布式表征战胜维数灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations; existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 2018 年，他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；此时他认为存在性风险极不可能。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
views.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 支持多样性采样与抽象，助力分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; AI shows self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，ChatGPT 之后他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化；AI 已表现出自我保存、欺骗与谄媚；即便 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with baked-in honesty and mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式贝叶斯预测器，内建诚实并具备数学安全保证，避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）用更多数据与算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks, and digital weights make AI immortal.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，数字权重让 AI 获得永生。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is learned from data.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介。

views.en: Once AI becomes an agent, self-preservation and power-seeking emerge as subgoals; superintelligence likely within 20 years, posing existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向风险主线：AI 一旦成为智能体，自我保存与权力寻求会作为子目标涌现；超级智能或在 20 年内出现，构成生存风险。

views.en: Alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter; regulation is the steering wheel, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张：对齐研究应优先于让 AI 更聪明，监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, and world models are learned, not hardwired.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化观点：自监督学习是智能的暗物质，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），世界模型是习得的而非硬编码的。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划，主张 JEPA 和开源，认为 AGI 是渐进过程。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA for reasoning and planning.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一代突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型来实现推理和规划。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他总结 LLM 是死胡同，世界模型在抽象表征空间预测才能实现安全、目标驱动的智能体，并强调开源和物理世界理解。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness matter as capabilities grow. Talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills first.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，随着能力提升，对齐与鲁棒性至关重要；人才缺口大于资金缺口，应先积累技能。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed. Evaluation is easier than generation.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究，并强调评估比生成更容易。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved and compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队被解散且算力承诺落空；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试与监管。

views.en: Alignment must be empirically tested and measured now, not deferred; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐必须当下就做实证测试与度量，而非推迟；对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是核心风险。

views.en: From individual skill-building and collaboration to institutional critique and regulation: his focus shifted from researcher paths to systemic accountability.
views.zh: 从 2018 年关注个人技能建设与机构合作，到 2024 年转向机构问责与监管，他的思考由研究者路径深化为系统性治理。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable via 10x yearly compute scaling; Google sat on ChatGPT-level tech since 2020.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而高度可预测，谷歌早在 2020 年就握有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守而未发布。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimal.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，而生存风险微乎其微。

views.en: Focus shifts to containment and alignment before release; superintelligence must stay on our team.
views.zh: 2025 年重心转向发布前的遏制与对齐，提出超级智能必须始终站在人类一边，并强调遏制优先于对齐。

views.en: Agents and companions replace OS and apps; modern Turing test measures economic value.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他主张从操作系统、应用转向智能体与伴侣，现代图灵测试应以经济价值衡量。

views.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持微软须自建前沿模型实现自给，并称 12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，计算的新单位已从芯片变成数据中心，强调算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计。

views.en: Three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—make inference compute demand explode a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并判断思维链带来的推理算力需求将暴涨十亿倍。

views.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each stage needs 100x more compute, and open models near the frontier.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为生成式→推理式→智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，并强调开源模型已接近前沿模型。

views.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the limit.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，缩放定律扩展为四条并加入智能体式扩展；他反共识地认为推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs rather than destroying them, and closes the technology divide.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（如放射科医生需求反增），并通过自然语言缩小技术鸿沟。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他主张基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可完成对齐，强调早期公开部署让社会适应，并判断算力将成为最稀缺的资源。

views.en: Scaling keeps compounding; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）持续复利，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is a profit center, not a cost.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）看作渐变而非里程碑，把超级智能定义为自主科学发现，并把算力视为利润中心而非成本。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; pause training if the safety case fails; keep humans in control of superintelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，安全论证不成立就暂停训练，并坚持人类必须始终掌控超级智能。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键；安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Scaling laws and one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026，她始终回望 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律早期并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 以 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业模式的信仰之跃。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心从部署转向交互模型：应是基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; durable progress beats compressing frontier AI progress.
views.zh: 2026 年她深化对齐立场：尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中，追求持久进步，而非把前沿模型的进展压缩在短时间内。

views.en: The future is not predestined; governance, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：未来并非注定，我们有能动性；制度设计、透明度与制衡，比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning, and flipped classrooms improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，翻转课堂也能改善校内教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and near-term bias matters more than long-term AGI alignment.
views.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习鲜有真实应用，近期的偏见问题比长期的 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows are already here.
views.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力，可用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, and agentic workflows plus coding skills deliver real value.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流加编程技能才创造真实价值。

views.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, open models preserve optionality, and data centers plus inference capacity drive competitiveness.
views.zh: 散布恐惧服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代工作，开放模型保留选择权，数据中心与推理（inference）算力决定竞争力。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他就提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表示学习。这奠定了他此后一贯的“想法重于规模”主线。

views.en: The keys were never in our hand; control is dangerous. Let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 同年他转向社会与治理层面：钥匙从未在我们手中，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，而非对齐到人类目标——这是他最鲜明的反共识立场。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他把矛头对准大语言模型：强化学习才是智能的核心范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本；真正的 Scaling 来自从经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and the reward hypothesis.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他给出建设性方案：AGI 需要无领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，靠开放式抽象与奖励假设支撑，并提出 Oak 架构；同时承认可靠的持续深度学习尚未解决。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake, and LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
views.zh: 最近他进一步深化：持续学习本就是学习的常态而非特例，合成数据是误区，LLM 只是智能的子集（语言仅占 20-25%）；单一系统无法学会一切，需要多个不同经验的系统——主线始终是从经验中学习。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling hardware and engineering, not ML science, drives AI; games are ideal testbeds for iterative training.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进步靠的是工程与硬件加速，而非机器学习科学本身；游戏因复杂度、人类基线和可扩展性成为理想试验场，迭代训练配记分板能带来指数级提升。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality; alignment learns human preferences; scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
views.zh: 2019 年他判断 AGI 是最具变革性的技术，深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性使其可行；对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把算力视为根本瓶颈，认为基础模型蕴含无限可能、后训练将其收敛为一致行为；AGI 是持续过程而非终点，能源与物理基础设施比算法更卡脖子。

views.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute becomes a basic right; the moat is the machine that makes models.
views.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律未见墙，算力将成为未来基本权利；真正的护城河是造模型的机器而非单一模型，智能体式编码已从写 20% 代码跃升至 80%。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security, alignment must scale as the bottleneck; personal proactive AGI is the goal.
views.zh: 2026 年他宣称已进入 AGI 时代，Astra 能连续运行 24 小时；安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步升级并成为进步瓶颈，终极产品是主动为你行动的个人 AGI，人类仍负责判断与担责。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作，政府应拥抱风险并实验。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software with human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化与带人类在环的智能体式企业软件。

views.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads across his thinking.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles and multiplanet life insurance drive breakthrough engineering.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理和成为多行星物种作为突破性工程的驱动力。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink scales bandwidth toward human-AI symbiosis, while population decline threatens civilization.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与追求真相，并让 Neuralink 提升带宽以实现人机共生，同时警告人口下降是文明最大威胁。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive within a year; Optimus and truth-seeking AI are central, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，Optimus 与追求真相的 AI 成为核心，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

views.en: Singularity now: AI-driven deflation brings universal high income; energy is the innermost loop, pushing compute and data centers toward space.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年，他宣称已身处奇点，AI 驱动的通缩带来普遍高收入，能源是最内层循环，推动算力与数据中心走向太空。

views.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; inference moves to orbit, robotaxi and Optimus scale, and peer review replaces government oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超越全人类智能，推理迁往轨道，Robotaxi 与 Optimus 规模化，并以同行评审取代政府监管。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute, but progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力上带来更多收益；AI 进步是平滑的指数增长，而非放缓。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation and economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出部署更小、更便宜模型的经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转移；是蒸馏和经济因素，而非技术极限，拖慢了预训练 Scaling。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities still lag text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches; deep progress remains elusive despite being a key area.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为多模态能力仍落后于文本，模型像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，深层进展依然难觅，尽管这是关键方向。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike human few-shot generalization.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从小样本泛化。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年，他讲授机器学习基础：监督学习可拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，架构已不再关键，AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4 到 50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection vulnerabilities.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

views.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't equal robustness; interpretability may become a real science via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出自动化红队测试已超越人类，模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

views.en: Architecture is not essential; data and Scaling drive complexity; safety requires explicit effort beyond Scaling.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：架构并非核心，数据与 Scaling（规模扩张）才是复杂性的来源；安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式努力。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic's Super Bowl Ads: A Blue Shell Attack on OpenAI?
The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute enable dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; models learn new skills, not just elicit knowledge. Reliability, not capability, is the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是预训练之外的新缩放轴，模型能学到新能力而非仅调取已有知识；智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed. Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI，无需新架构；编码因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域。

views.en: Inference compute becomes the major bottleneck by 2028; compute is the new oil, chip supply the current constraint. Progress is exponential, not plateauing.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化算力主线：推理算力将在 2028 年前成为主要瓶颈，算力是“新石油”、芯片供应是当前约束；进展是指数级的，并未见顶。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence now; work becomes managing fleets of agents. World models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：当下编排比原始智能更重要，工作是管理智能体集群；世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

episodes.tEn: Inside China's AI Labs: Nathan Lambert on Open Models, Compute Constraints, and US-China Divergence
Open Models as the Engine for the Next Decade of AI Research
AI State of the Art: DeepSeek, Claude Opus 4.5, and the Global Race
AI2 Launches Fully Open Almo 3 Models, Challenging Closed-Source AI
Post-Training Recipes and RLVR with Nathan Lambert
Tulu 3: Open Source Post-Training for LLMs
AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将延续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

views.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心从 RLHF 转向后训练配方：数据质量远比算法选择重要，后训练分为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）三阶段。

views.en: RLVR is the key breakthrough for reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots mislead.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为推理与工具使用的关键突破，同时警告强化学习中的过度优化，并称推理时 Scaling 曲线是一种被高估的“错觉”。

views.en: Open models, led by Chinese labs, become the engine of research; full transparency means data, checkpoints, and recipes.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开放模型将驱动未来十年研究，中国实验室凭战略开放主导，真正的开放需透明到数据、中间检查点与配方。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling，AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化而非突变奇点到来。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

episodes.tEn: Alexander Wang on Founding Scale at 19
Meta's AI Journey: From Llama 4 to Muse Spark and Beyond
Alex Wang on Meta's AI Strategy and New Model Release
AI's Acceleration: From Pre-training to Recursive Self-Improvement
Alex Wang on Neuralink, AI, and the Future of Humanity
From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data is the key bottleneck, not compute. Boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；枯燥的 AI 应用（如表格处理、放射学）将产生巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新的代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素是数据和后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data needs tricks. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专业数据进行后训练是关键，合成数据需要技巧；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm. Agents finally work, starting with coding. AI is centralizing, not democratizing.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚信缩放定律持续有效，递归自我改进标志着新范式；智能体终于开始工作，从编程起步；AI 是集中化而非民主化技术。

views.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build around this belief. Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release based on safety.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念构建组织；Meta 从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

Claude Code: The Future of AI Agents and Software Engineering
Claude Tag: Proactive AI That Remembers and Acts Autonomously
AI Coding on Phone: Boris on 8B Tokens & ROI
The Origin of Claude Code: From Accident to Agent
Will AI Replace Software Engineers?
Claude Code's Explosive Growth and the Future of AI Agents

Claude Code: The End of Software Engineering as We Know It
Building for the Model 6 Months from Now: The Accidental Creation of Claude Code
Boris Cherny: From Meta to Claude Code, Building Products with Generalists

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作产品第一原则，并强调能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的通才是最有价值的工程师。

views.en: Coding is becoming solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, scaffolding is temporary tech debt, and the software engineer title may fade.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编程正被解决：自己的代码已 100% 由 Claude Code 写就，脚手架只是临时技术债，「软件工程师」头衔可能消失。

views.en: The printing-press analogy deepens: engineers become multidisciplinary builders, code volume per engineer rises 200-250%, and non-engineers adopt agentic tools.
views.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他用印刷术类比深化这一判断：工程师转型为跨学科构建者，人均代码量增长 200–250%，非工程师也开始使用智能体式工具。

views.en: Focus shifts to loops and ROI: the next abstraction after agents is loops, and the bottlenecks become code review, security, and idea generation.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，重心转向循环与 ROI：智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环，瓶颈变成代码审查、安全和创意生成。

views.en: Proactive, self-improving agents arrive: Claude Tag acts autonomously with memory, and models may self-improve by 2028 while safety stays core.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他描述主动式、可自我改进的智能体：Claude Tag 具备记忆并自主行动，模型或在 2028 年前自我改进，而对齐与安全始终是核心。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图、转向按周迭代；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味成为稀缺技能。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, not writing code.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断，而非亲手写代码。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，加上明确的内部留存与打磨标准，是每个功能公开发布前的门槛。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment improved.
views.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬性约束；随着模型判断力提升，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

views.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine.
views.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，只要有好的测试套件，重写就没问题。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具所能发挥的更聪明；工具工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
views.zh: 规划是迭代的人机对话，而非静态规格；随着模型变聪明，计划模式可能过时。

views.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
views.zh: 模型越聪明，所需指令越少；更精简、原则驱动的提示优于详细规则和示例。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art for novel problems, not for zero-to-one innovation.
views.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少自指偏差；评估对新问题更像艺术，不适用于从零到一的创新。

views.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and model-built context are preferable.
views.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式；基于图的方法和模型自建上下文更可取。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership: dogfooding builds empathy; one-on-ones for live talk; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
views.zh: 领导力层面：吃自己的狗粮能建立共情，一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新；使命对齐与速度是文化驱动力。

views.en: Scaling Claude Code: engineering bandwidth no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are. Planning JIT, PRs replace design docs.
views.zh: Scaling Claude Code：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划变为即时制，PR 取代设计文档。

views.en: Code is source of truth; docs sync with AI help. Managers start as ICs to dogfood; kill old processes; flat orgs.
views.zh: 代码是唯一事实来源，文档借助 AI 保持同步。管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮；砍掉过时流程；组织尽量扁平。

views.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with high accountability key. Verification and quality frameworks matter more as code velocity rises.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责制是关键。随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更重要。

views.en: AI era: growth mindset and leaning into AI essential. Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost; outcomes over output.
views.zh: AI 时代：成长心态与拥抱 AI 至关重要。工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；心流状态消失；关注结果而非产出。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
views.zh: 2024 年时他强调：预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）的回报在递减，进一步进展需要算法创新，而推理阶段的算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，能突破预训练瓶颈。

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
views.zh: 他始终认为，从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是不变的核心主线。

views.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调给模型工具（搜索、代码执行、浏览器）能实现超越静态权重的智能体式行为，而长上下文窗口充当工作记忆。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
views.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持缩放定律有效，但指出持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力，并认为苦涩的教训意味着通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

views.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
views.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识。

views.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers matter; OpenAI creates stars rather than only hiring them.
views.zh: 人才密度与保护顶尖研究者至关重要；OpenAI 是造就明星，而非只是招揽明星。

views.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却难胜任主观领域。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
views.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证的严格程度成正比。

views.en: Evals are in crisis as canonical benchmarks saturate; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
views.zh: 评测陷入危机，经典基准已饱和；评测团队应与建模团队分离以防作弊。

views.en: Models lack taste; human researchers are still needed for idea generation and frontier collaboration.
views.zh: 模型缺乏品味；创意生成与前沿研究仍需人类研究者协作。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity, not hardware, is the bottleneck, and open source plus world models can solve generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：瓶颈不是硬件而是数据多样性，开源与世界模型能解决泛化问题。

views.en: Open source is crucial for safety: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and open models win long-term on cost and control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调开源对安全至关重要：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，长期看开源模型会因成本与控制权胜出。

views.en: His role shifts from shipping libraries to building a meta-community, enabling others rather than pushing his own stack.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的角色从发布自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能他人而非推销自己的技术栈。

views.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes or guardrails, is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源与闭源同安全正交；随着模型能力增强，真正的安全层是对齐，而非沙箱或护栏。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', making monitoring unreliable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；推理轨迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控不再可靠。

views.en: He now supports openness and a deliberate slowdown at once, arguing a slowdown needs international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
views.zh: 2026 年，他同时支持开放与有意放缓，认为放缓需要国际合作与开放科学，以避免监管俘获。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; confidence metrics build trust.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

views.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins to diverse biomolecules, narrowing hypothesis space for experiments.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出，AlphaFold 3 用扩散架构把能力从蛋白质扩展到多种生物分子，帮助缩小假设空间、让实验更高效。

views.en: AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them; trust in AI will grow like trust in the internet.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 AI 工具是加速科学家而非取代他们，社会对 AI 的信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not Scaling alone, drove its success.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，成功靠专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; Scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调预训练提供广度，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；同时质疑仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，并认为下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位。

views.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can boost smaller models; language is the best medium for reasoning, but AI safety faces value pluralism.
views.zh: 2023 年，她提出推理阶段的算法与高质量合成数据能让更小模型比肩大模型；语言是推理的最佳媒介，但 AI 安全因价值多元而成为棘手的计算问题。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年，她将数据视为根本瓶颈，指出当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越；强化学习需要精细工程才能超越监督微调，并强调开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

views.en: Abductive reasoning is key to scientific discovery; falsification matters more than hypothesis generation. AI must explore unknown knowledge beyond human knowledge.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为溯因推理是科学发现的关键，证伪比假设生成更重要；AI 需要探索人类知识之外的未知领域，否则可能沦为 AI 服务 AI 或人类服务 AI。

views.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment respects diverse values.
views.zh: 2026 年，她进一步论证小语言模型借助高质量、多样化的合成数据可以很强大；预训练阶段的强化学习能通过奖励信息增益提升推理；多元对齐比消除互联网偏见更可行。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, and video learning can train agents without costly RL.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样延伸人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，并主张用视频学习替代昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential to beneficial AI; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not only large models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调，多元与包容是造出有益技术的前提，基础创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非全部。

views.en: The goal is AI that augments scientists and workers, creating new symbols and knowledge, not just scaling existing models.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他的一贯主线是：AI 应增强科学家与劳动者、创造新符号与新知识，而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，直言安全仍是尚无解法的开放问题。

views.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogs legacy gaps, and language models can transform local-language education.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越历史包袱，语言模型可变革本地语言教育。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他认为超越训练分布的泛化能力是机器学习缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，并强调样本效率与跨机器人泛化。

views.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static tasks to dynamic motion via neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies.
views.zh: 2020 年，他主张机器人学习要从准静态任务走向动态任务，用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略实现平滑动态运动和对新形态的零样本泛化。

views.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, are the bottleneck for embodied intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：具身智能的瓶颈是数据与泛化，而非单纯算法；早期用好奇心与仿真补数据，后期转向多源数据预训练。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretrain on videos and simulation, then post-train on real-world data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要用视频与仿真做预训练，再用真实世界数据做后训练。

views.en: Shift in emphasis: from curiosity-driven exploration to a general-purpose brain and a data flywheel; deployment, not scaling, is the hard part.
views.zh: 2026 年立场深化与转变：从好奇心驱动探索转向通用大脑与数据飞轮，并强调部署本身才是技术难题，机器人无法像软件那样一夜扩张。
